HostReply_activateHostArtifact.description:
Reply to activateHostArtifact; match the request id. Outer ok:false reports a transport or dispatch error; outer ok:true can contain an inline logical operation failure (result.ok:false). Successful media and file chunks use binary frames, not inline JSON bytes. Usage: Install a selected staged binary or pair and restart the standalone daemon.
Inputs: Supply its staged upload ID, an operation ID, the target executable and its expected SHA-256. A paired deployment also supplies the staged runner ID and digest.
Invariants: Valid only on a supported standalone install and the server link that staged the artifacts. Replaying an admitted operation ID cannot trigger a second activation.
Effects: The worker verifies and preflights the resulting pair before force-draining, even when busy. Restart interrupts active sessions, terminals and host operations; pending results can be lost. It backs up existing binaries before replacing them. If the runner is absent, a paired deployment creates it without overwriting a concurrently added file. The worker restarts the unit once; acceptance is not completion.
Recovery: Read hostArtifactActivationStatus with the same operation ID after reconnect. Never blindly retry or automatically roll back a restart.
HostReply_activateHostArtifact.name: HostReply_activateHostArtifact
HostReply_activateHostArtifact.title: HostReply_activateHostArtifact

HostReply_addProject.description:

Inputs: Supply path and optional launch configuration.
Invariants: Invalid paths produce project-specific errors; worktrees resolve to their main repository.
Effects: Updates the daemon project registry.
Recovery: Inspect the registry after an uncertain result before repeating.
HostReply_addProject.name: HostReply_addProject
HostReply_addProject.title: HostReply_addProject

HostReply_archiveSession.name: HostReply_archiveSession
HostReply_archiveSession.title: HostReply_archiveSession

Inputs: path selects a host directory or null selects the initial location.
Invariants: Results describe host filesystem directories, not registered projects.

HostReply_browseDirectories.name: HostReply_browseDirectories
HostReply_browseDirectories.title: HostReply_browseDirectories

Inputs: Supply the exact session ID and tab ID from discovery.
Invariants: No caller-supplied CDP endpoint or browser input is accepted; capture is bounded.
Effects: Captures a single JPEG without changing browser lifecycle.
Recovery: Rediscover after tab or session changes.
HostReply_browserCapture.name: HostReply_browserCapture
HostReply_browserCapture.title: HostReply_browserCapture

HostReply_browserControl.description:
Reply to browserControl; match the request id. Outer ok:false reports a transport or dispatch error; outer ok:true can contain an inline logical operation failure (result.ok:false). Successful media and file chunks use binary frames, not inline JSON bytes. Usage: Control a session-owned browser tab with a bounded ordered batch.
Inputs: Supply the session ID, target ID and 1–64 actions from the browser control contract.
Invariants: Whole-batch validation precedes dispatch; the runner rechecks ownership before each action; no runner or browser is started and no CDP endpoint is exposed.
Effects: Applies actions sequentially through one CDP session; failure stops the batch and may leave an applied prefix.
Recovery: Delivery of a prefix may be uncertain; never automatically retry the batch or remaining actions.
HostReply_browserControl.name: HostReply_browserControl
HostReply_browserControl.title: HostReply_browserControl

HostReply_createWorkspace.title: HostReply_createWorkspace

HostReply_defaultCwd.title: HostReply_defaultCwd

HostReply_deleteSession.description:
Reply to deleteSession; match the request id. Outer ok:false reports a transport or dispatch error; outer ok:true can contain an inline logical operation failure (result.ok:false). Successful media and file chunks use binary frames, not inline JSON bytes. Usage: Delete the selected session while preserving its child sessions.
Inputs: Supply the selected ID and the caller's liveSessionIds snapshot; the daemon also fences live processes.
Invariants: Direct children keep their files. Eligible parentSession references are rewritten to the deleted session's parent, preserving path-versus-ID form; live or oversized child files are not rewritten and skipped rewrites are reported.
Effects: Deletes the selected session and atomically rewrites eligible direct-child headers; it does not delete descendants.
Recovery: Reconcile the selected session, preserved children and skippedChildren after an uncertain response before repeating the deletion; a successful deletion does not prove every child reference was rewritten.
HostReply_deleteSession.name: HostReply_deleteSession
HostReply_deleteSession.title: HostReply_deleteSession

Effects: Changes the daemon's editing fence.
Recovery: Re-establish membership and lease before editing after disconnect.
HostReply_editLease.name: HostReply_editLease
HostReply_editLease.title: HostReply_editLease

HostReply_exportSession.name: HostReply_exportSession
HostReply_exportSession.title: HostReply_exportSession

HostReply_fileIndex.name: HostReply_fileIndex
HostReply_fileIndex.title: HostReply_fileIndex

HostReply_fileInfo.title: HostReply_fileInfo

HostReply_hideProject.description:

HostReply_hideProject.title: HostReply_hideProject

HostReply_hierarchy.description:
Reply to hierarchy; match the request id. Outer ok:false reports a transport or dispatch error; outer ok:true can contain an inline logical operation failure (result.ok:false). Successful media and file chunks use binary frames, not inline JSON bytes. Usage: Inspect or change the registered project/workspace/session hierarchy.
Inputs: Action-specific IDs, host paths, imports or project metadata select the operation; nullable metadata clears it.
Invariants: Discovery yields candidates; importing or registering changes canonical membership and is distinct from filesystem discovery. listProjectIcons scans at most five directory levels below the project root and examines at most 2,000 entries, returning at most 24 icons of at most 256 KiB each. It skips hidden names, symlinks, node_modules, vendor, dist and release, and applies Git ignore rules when available. Results are best-effort, not an exhaustive inventory.
Effects: Mutations persist hierarchy changes; list and discovery return snapshots.
Recovery: Re-read the hierarchy before repeating an uncertain mutation.
HostReply_hierarchy.name: HostReply_hierarchy
HostReply_hierarchy.title: HostReply_hierarchy

HostReply_home.description:

Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: The returned path belongs to the host machine, not the browser.
Effects: Reads process environment state.
Recovery: Re-query after reconnecting to a host.
HostReply_home.name: HostReply_home
HostReply_home.title: HostReply_home

Reply to hostArtifactActivationStatus; match the request id. Outer ok:false reports a transport or dispatch error; outer ok:true can contain an inline logical operation failure (result.ok:false). Inputs: Supply the original operation ID.
Invariants: State belongs to the daemon and the server relationship that requested the activation. A missing receipt does not prove that the operation ran or failed.
Effects: Reads durable state without installing, restarting or retrying.
Recovery: Poll after the link returns. If the outcome stays unknown, inspect the service and backup on the host before retrying.
HostReply_hostArtifactActivationStatus.name: HostReply_hostArtifactActivationStatus
HostReply_hostArtifactActivationStatus.title: HostReply_hostArtifactActivationStatus

Recovery: Retry after reconnect, or inspect the managed binaries if they cannot be read.
HostReply_hostInstalledBinaryDigests.name: HostReply_hostInstalledBinaryDigests
HostReply_hostInstalledBinaryDigests.title: HostReply_hostInstalledBinaryDigests

HostReply_hostSettingsSet.name: HostReply_hostSettingsSet
HostReply_hostSettingsSet.title: HostReply_hostSettingsSet

HostReply_inspectUploads.title: HostReply_inspectUploads

Recovery: After reconnect, establish a fresh watch and snapshot.
HostReply_unwatchFile.name: HostReply_unwatchFile
HostReply_unwatchFile.title: HostReply_unwatchFile

HostReply_updateProject.description:
Reply to updateProject; match the request id. Outer ok:false reports a transport or dispatch error; outer ok:true can contain an inline logical operation failure (result.ok:false). Successful media and file chunks use binary frames, not inline JSON bytes. Usage: Apply project presentation updates.
Inputs: Supply updates with cwd and optional nullable fields.
Invariants: Duplicate targets merge per field, with later defined values winning; hidden entries are untouched. Invalid new paths in a bulk update can be skipped, while an entirely invalid batch fails. newRoots identifies newly registered roots.
Effects: Mutates registry entries in one save.
Recovery: Read the registry after uncertain delivery before repeating.
HostReply_updateProject.name: HostReply_updateProject
HostReply_updateProject.title: HostReply_updateProject

HostReply_uploadAbort.description:
Reply to uploadAbort; match the request id. Outer ok:false reports a transport or dispatch error; outer ok:true can contain an inline logical operation failure (result.ok:false). Successful media and file chunks use binary frames, not inline JSON bytes. Usage: Cancel a staged upload.
Inputs: Supply its UUID.
Invariants: Upload controls are ordered per upload; an earlier attach cannot undo cancellation.
Effects: Aborts staged data owned by this link; void success omits res.result.
Recovery: Reconcile upload state after a lost response before proceeding.
HostReply_uploadAbort.name: HostReply_uploadAbort
HostReply_uploadAbort.title: HostReply_uploadAbort

HostReply_uploadAttach.description:
Reply to uploadAttach; match the request id. Outer ok:false reports a transport or dispatch error; outer ok:true can contain an inline logical operation failure (result.ok:false). Successful media and file chunks use binary frames, not inline JSON bytes. Usage: Attach a completed staged upload to a session.
Inputs: Supply upload ID and daemon-local session identity and file.
Invariants: The retained generation must exist; existing names are not overwritten. Repeating for the same destination is idempotent only while its receipt target exists, but a different consumed destination is 404.
Effects: Installs the file under local/uploads, choosing another name on collision; cross-device copies may take ten minutes.
Recovery: Retry the same destination after an uncertain response, not a different destination.
HostReply_uploadAttach.name: HostReply_uploadAttach
HostReply_uploadAttach.title: HostReply_uploadAttach

HostReply_uploadStart.description:
Reply to uploadStart; match the request id. Outer ok:false reports a transport or dispatch error; outer ok:true can contain an inline logical operation failure (result.ok:false). Successful media and file chunks use binary frames, not inline JSON bytes. Usage: Create or resume a staged upload.
Inputs: Supply upload ID, attempt generation, name, MIME type and byte size; binary pieces follow separately.
Invariants: Reusing an ID with different metadata conflicts; acknowledgements are attempt-bound. Completed attachment receipts require the retained target to exist, not merely a stored receipt.
Effects: Creates or resumes daemon-local staged data; inactive staged files are swept after 24 hours.
Recovery: Resume with matching metadata and use the acknowledged offset, not stale attempt acknowledgements.
HostReply_uploadStart.name: HostReply_uploadStart
HostReply_uploadStart.title: HostReply_uploadStart

HostReply_usageReport.description:
Reply to usageReport; match the request id. Outer ok:false reports a transport or dispatch error; outer ok:true can contain an inline logical operation failure (result.ok:false). Successful media and file chunks use binary frames, not inline JSON bytes. Usage: Report token usage and estimated costs on the selected daemon.
Inputs: Supply optional date, granularity and project filters, or request a refresh.
Invariants: Requires canReportUsage; aggregates only this daemon's transcripts, and costs are not an authoritative provider bill.
Effects: Reads transcripts and synchronizes the daemon's usage database. Refresh invalidates local caches.
Recovery: Reconnect or upgrade the selected daemon and retry on the same host.
HostReply_usageReport.name: HostReply_usageReport
HostReply_usageReport.title: HostReply_usageReport

HostReply_validateCwd.description:
Reply to validateCwd; match the request id. Outer ok:false reports a transport or dispatch error; outer ok:true can contain an inline logical operation failure (result.ok:false). Successful media and file chunks use binary frames, not inline JSON bytes. Usage: Validate a working directory and resolve its project.
Inputs: Supply a daemon-local path.
Invariants: Missing paths and non-directories fail.
Effects: Reads filesystem and project information without starting a runner.
Recovery: Correct the path or filesystem state before retrying.
HostReply_validateCwd.name: HostReply_validateCwd
HostReply_validateCwd.title: HostReply_validateCwd

HostReply_watchFile.description:
Reply to watchFile; match the request id. Outer ok:false reports a transport or dispatch error; outer ok:true can contain an inline logical operation failure (result.ok:false). Successful media and file chunks use binary frames, not inline JSON bytes. Usage: Watch a workspace file and obtain initial metadata.
Inputs: id, epoch and file request identify the watch instance and host file.
Invariants: The target must be a file; epoch distinguishes successive watches, and startup can return watch_closed.
Effects: Registers a watch that emits file events until closed or disconnected.
Recovery: Reopen with a fresh epoch and refresh metadata after disconnection.
HostReply_watchFile.name: HostReply_watchFile
HostReply_watchFile.title: HostReply_watchFile

HostReply_workspaceBranches.description:
Reply to workspaceBranches; match the request id. Outer ok:false reports a transport or dispatch error; outer ok:true can contain an inline logical operation failure (result.ok:false). Successful media and file chunks use binary frames, not inline JSON bytes. Usage: List branch choices for workspace creation.
Inputs: projectPath is a registered host project path.
Invariants: The local default is preferred; origin's default is a second choice only when it has commits missing locally. Other choices exclude checked-out branches. GitHub pull requests include drafts.
Effects: Refreshes remote-tracking refs and queries GitHub if configured, without creating a branch or checkout.
Recovery: Reopen the picker to refresh refs; a remote that couldn't be refreshed uses cached refs.
HostReply_workspaceBranches.name: HostReply_workspaceBranches
HostReply_workspaceBranches.title: HostReply_workspaceBranches

HostReply_workspaceCreationSettings.description:
Reply to workspaceCreationSettings; match the request id. Outer ok:false reports a transport or dispatch error; outer ok:true can contain an inline logical operation failure (result.ok:false). Successful media and file chunks use binary frames, not inline JSON bytes. Usage: Read or update workspace creation settings.
Inputs: Optional projectPath selects project settings; omitted fields remain unchanged and null override clears it.
Invariants: Defaults, override and source determine the effective creation pipeline.
Effects: Supplied settings are persisted; a read returns the current settings.
Recovery: Re-read settings after an uncertain update before making another change.
HostReply_workspaceCreationSettings.name: HostReply_workspaceCreationSettings
HostReply_workspaceCreationSettings.title: HostReply_workspaceCreationSettings

HostReply_workspaceCreationStatus.description:
Reply to workspaceCreationStatus; match the request id. Outer ok:false reports a transport or dispatch error; outer ok:true can contain an inline logical operation failure (result.ok:false). Successful media and file chunks use binary frames, not inline JSON bytes. Usage: Read an asynchronous creation job.
Inputs: id identifies the host job.
Invariants: Stage, status and logs describe recorded progress; interrupted is distinct from failure.
Effects: Observes job state, including recovery of interrupted work.
Recovery: Inspect the job and workspace before restarting creation.
HostReply_workspaceCreationStatus.name: HostReply_workspaceCreationStatus
HostReply_workspaceCreationStatus.title: HostReply_workspaceCreationStatus

HostRequest_activateHostArtifact.description:
Usage: Install a selected staged binary or pair and restart the standalone daemon.
Inputs: Supply its staged upload ID, an operation ID, the target executable and its expected SHA-256. A paired deployment also supplies the staged runner ID and digest.
Invariants: Valid only on a supported standalone install and the server link that staged the artifacts. Replaying an admitted operation ID cannot trigger a second activation.
Effects: The worker verifies and preflights the resulting pair before force-draining, even when busy. Restart interrupts active sessions, terminals and host operations; pending results can be lost. It backs up existing binaries before replacing them. If the runner is absent, a paired deployment creates it without overwriting a concurrently added file. The worker restarts the unit once; acceptance is not completion.
Recovery: Read hostArtifactActivationStatus with the same operation ID after reconnect. Never blindly retry or automatically roll back a restart.
HostRequest_activateHostArtifact.name: HostRequest_activateHostArtifact
HostRequest_activateHostArtifact.title: HostRequest_activateHostArtifact

HostRequest_addProject.description:
Usage: Register a project.
Inputs: Supply path and optional launch configuration.
Invariants: Invalid paths produce project-specific errors; worktrees resolve to their main repository.
Effects: Updates the daemon project registry.
Recovery: Inspect the registry after an uncertain result before repeating.
HostRequest_addProject.name: HostRequest_addProject
HostRequest_addProject.title: HostRequest_addProject

HostRequest_archiveSession.description:
Usage: Archive a session and its artifacts.
Inputs: Supply session ID.
Invariants: The session must exist.
Effects: Moves the session and artifacts into the archive.
Recovery: Inspect active and archived inventories after an uncertain response before repeating.
HostRequest_archiveSession.name: HostRequest_archiveSession
HostRequest_archiveSession.title: HostRequest_archiveSession

HostRequest_browseDirectories.description:
Usage: Browse host directories.
Inputs: path selects a host directory or null selects the initial location.
Invariants: Results describe host filesystem directories, not registered projects.
Effects: Reads directory entries.
Recovery: Refresh after filesystem changes or choose an accessible path.
HostRequest_browseDirectories.name: HostRequest_browseDirectories
HostRequest_browseDirectories.title: HostRequest_browseDirectories

HostRequest_browserCapture.description:
Usage: Capture one session-owned browser tab.
Inputs: Supply the exact session ID and tab ID from discovery.
Invariants: No caller-supplied CDP endpoint or browser input is accepted; capture is bounded.
Effects: Captures a single JPEG without changing browser lifecycle.
Recovery: Rediscover after tab or session changes.
HostRequest_browserCapture.name: HostRequest_browserCapture
HostRequest_browserCapture.title: HostRequest_browserCapture

HostRequest_browserControl.description:
Usage: Control a session-owned browser tab with a bounded ordered batch.
Inputs: Supply the session ID, target ID and 1–64 actions from the browser control contract.
Invariants: Whole-batch validation precedes dispatch; the runner rechecks ownership before each action; no runner or browser is started and no CDP endpoint is exposed.
Effects: Applies actions sequentially through one CDP session; failure stops the batch and may leave an applied prefix.
Recovery: Delivery of a prefix may be uncertain; never automatically retry the batch or remaining actions.
HostRequest_browserControl.name: HostRequest_browserControl
HostRequest_browserControl.title: HostRequest_browserControl

HostRequest_browserList.description:
Usage: Discover browser tabs belonging to an already-live session.
Inputs: Supply its exact session ID.
Invariants: Never starts or attaches a runner or browser.
Effects: Queries the session's runner.
Recovery: Rediscover after reconnect or session changes.
HostRequest_browserList.name: HostRequest_browserList
HostRequest_browserList.title: HostRequest_browserList

HostRequest_browserVideoNext.description:
Usage: Manage a session-owned encoded browser video stream.
Inputs: Supply the session and exact target and stream identifiers.
Invariants: Video is bounded and ephemeral; ownership is checked by the runner.
Effects: Starts, consumes, or stops the stream.
Recovery: Restart after disconnect or decoder failure.
HostRequest_browserVideoNext.name: HostRequest_browserVideoNext
HostRequest_browserVideoNext.title: HostRequest_browserVideoNext

HostRequest_browserVideoStart.description:
Usage: Manage a session-owned encoded browser video stream.
Inputs: Supply the session and exact target and stream identifiers.
Invariants: Video is bounded and ephemeral; ownership is checked by the runner.
Effects: Starts, consumes, or stops the stream.
Recovery: Restart after disconnect or decoder failure.
HostRequest_browserVideoStart.name: HostRequest_browserVideoStart
HostRequest_browserVideoStart.title: HostRequest_browserVideoStart

HostRequest_browserVideoStop.description:
Usage: Manage a session-owned encoded browser video stream.
Inputs: Supply the session and exact target and stream identifiers.
Invariants: Video is bounded and ephemeral; ownership is checked by the runner.
Effects: Starts, consumes, or stops the stream.
Recovery: Restart after disconnect or decoder failure.
HostRequest_browserVideoStop.name: HostRequest_browserVideoStop
HostRequest_browserVideoStop.title: HostRequest_browserVideoStop

HostRequest_cancelClone.description:
Usage: Cancel an active clone.
Inputs: id identifies the host clone job.
Invariants: Returned progress reports its resulting state; cancellation can race completion.
Effects: Requests termination of the clone process and cleanup of its target.
Recovery: Read progress and inspect the target before starting again.
HostRequest_cancelClone.name: HostRequest_cancelClone
HostRequest_cancelClone.title: HostRequest_cancelClone

HostRequest_chatRolesList.description:
Usage: Resolve chat roles for a workspace on the selected daemon.
Inputs: Supply an absolute workspace cwd and optionally the current composer thinking selector and current provider/model ID pair.
Invariants: Uses the workspace's native OMP settings and registry without returning secrets; the model pair supplies the temporary runner's default-role fallback.
Effects: Starts a temporary runner on the daemon.
Recovery: Correct the path or configuration and retry on the same host.
HostRequest_chatRolesList.name: HostRequest_chatRolesList
HostRequest_chatRolesList.title: HostRequest_chatRolesList

HostRequest_close.description:
Usage: Leave a runner channel.
Inputs: Supply the channel identity.
Invariants: Closing this server's membership does not kill a peer's process.
Effects: The daemon manages abandonment and idle cleanup.
Recovery: Reconcile membership after a lost response before assuming the process stopped.
HostRequest_close.name: HostRequest_close
HostRequest_close.title: HostRequest_close

HostRequest_closeFile.description:
Usage: Close a chunked file reader.
Inputs: id identifies the host reader.
Invariants: The handle is no longer usable after close.
Effects: Releases reader resources.
Recovery: If uncertain, discard the handle and open a new reader when needed.
HostRequest_closeFile.name: HostRequest_closeFile
HostRequest_closeFile.title: HostRequest_closeFile

HostRequest_createWorkspace.description:
Usage: Start an asynchronous workspace creation job.
Inputs: projectPath, branch, mode, baseRef and name select the host checkout and branch. New branches can use refs/pull/<number>/head for GitHub pull requests.
Invariants: The job captures its pipeline and progresses through stages; failure can leave partial work.
Effects: Runs configured commands and creates a worktree and registration.
Recovery: Poll the job and inspect the checkout before retrying after an uncertain response.
HostRequest_createWorkspace.name: HostRequest_createWorkspace
HostRequest_createWorkspace.title: HostRequest_createWorkspace

HostRequest_defaultCwd.description:
Usage: Get the host default working directory.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: The path is on the host machine.
Effects: Reads host configuration or environment.
Recovery: Re-query after reconnecting to a different host.
HostRequest_defaultCwd.name: HostRequest_defaultCwd
HostRequest_defaultCwd.title: HostRequest_defaultCwd

HostRequest_deleteSession.description:
Usage: Delete the selected session while preserving its child sessions.
Inputs: Supply the selected ID and the caller's liveSessionIds snapshot; the daemon also fences live processes.
Invariants: Direct children keep their files. Eligible parentSession references are rewritten to the deleted session's parent, preserving path-versus-ID form; live or oversized child files are not rewritten and skipped rewrites are reported.
Effects: Deletes the selected session and atomically rewrites eligible direct-child headers; it does not delete descendants.
Recovery: Reconcile the selected session, preserved children and skippedChildren after an uncertain response before repeating the deletion; a successful deletion does not prove every child reference was rewritten.
HostRequest_deleteSession.name: HostRequest_deleteSession
HostRequest_deleteSession.title: HostRequest_deleteSession

HostRequest_editLease.description:
Usage: Acquire or release a history-edit lease.
Inputs: Supply channel and desired on/off state.
Invariants: Conflicting peers are refused before editing; ownership follows membership.
Effects: Changes the daemon's editing fence.
Recovery: Re-establish membership and lease before editing after disconnect.
HostRequest_editLease.name: HostRequest_editLease
HostRequest_editLease.title: HostRequest_editLease

HostRequest_exportSession.description:
Usage: Export a session as HTML.
Inputs: Supply session ID.
Invariants: The session and omp executable must be available.
Effects: Runs omp export using a temporary file, then returns HTML and a suggested filename; it does not start a session runner.
Recovery: Restore the missing session or executable before retrying.
HostRequest_exportSession.name: HostRequest_exportSession
HostRequest_exportSession.title: HostRequest_exportSession

HostRequest_fileIndex.description:
Usage: Search or list indexed workspace paths.
Inputs: cwd is a host directory; query, limit, kind, refresh and optional owner constrain the request.
Invariants: Results can be truncated and reflect the index rather than a guaranteed live filesystem snapshot.
Effects: May refresh the index; otherwise reads indexed state.
Recovery: Refresh and repeat the query when stale results matter.
HostRequest_fileIndex.name: HostRequest_fileIndex
HostRequest_fileIndex.title: HostRequest_fileIndex

HostRequest_fileInfo.description:
Usage: Inspect a workspace filesystem entry.
Inputs: File request supplies path segments and optional session ownership.
Invariants: Paths resolve on the host and access restrictions apply.
Effects: Reads file metadata, not file contents.
Recovery: Re-query after a change; metadata is a snapshot.
HostRequest_fileInfo.name: HostRequest_fileInfo
HostRequest_fileInfo.title: HostRequest_fileInfo

HostRequest_gitDiff.description:
Usage: Inspect a file's Git diff.
Inputs: cwd, path and optional owner identify a host checkout and file.
Invariants: A diff may be unsupported; patch is present only when available.
Effects: Reads Git and filesystem state.
Recovery: Refresh after changes rather than applying an old patch as current state.
HostRequest_gitDiff.name: HostRequest_gitDiff
HostRequest_gitDiff.title: HostRequest_gitDiff

HostRequest_githubRepo.description:
Usage: Resolve a checkout's GitHub repository.
Inputs: cwd is a host checkout path.
Invariants: repo can be null when no GitHub repository is resolved.
Effects: Inspects repository configuration.
Recovery: Re-query after remote configuration changes.
HostRequest_githubRepo.name: HostRequest_githubRepo
HostRequest_githubRepo.title: HostRequest_githubRepo

HostRequest_gitOrigins.description:
Usage: Resolve Git origins for host paths.
Inputs: paths contains at most 500 host paths.
Invariants: Results preserve input order; origin can be null and mainCheckout distinguishes the main checkout.
Effects: Inspects Git configuration without changing it.
Recovery: Re-query after remote or worktree changes.
HostRequest_gitOrigins.name: HostRequest_gitOrigins
HostRequest_gitOrigins.title: HostRequest_gitOrigins

HostRequest_gitStatus.description:
Usage: Inspect Git status for a host checkout.
Inputs: cwd and optional owner identify the workspace context.
Invariants: File status and index/worktree codes are a point-in-time Git observation.
Effects: Reads repository state without modifying it.
Recovery: Refresh after filesystem or Git changes.
HostRequest_gitStatus.name: HostRequest_gitStatus
HostRequest_gitStatus.title: HostRequest_gitStatus

HostRequest_hideProject.description:
Usage: Hide a project.
Inputs: Supply its path.
Invariants: Hidden registry entries suppress sidebar rediscovery until added again.
Effects: Updates registry visibility.
Recovery: Inspect registry state after an uncertain response.
HostRequest_hideProject.name: HostRequest_hideProject
HostRequest_hideProject.title: HostRequest_hideProject

HostRequest_hierarchy.description:
Usage: Inspect or change the registered project/workspace/session hierarchy.
Inputs: Action-specific IDs, host paths, imports or project metadata select the operation; nullable metadata clears it.
Invariants: Discovery yields candidates; importing or registering changes canonical membership and is distinct from filesystem discovery. listProjectIcons scans at most five directory levels below the project root and examines at most 2,000 entries, returning at most 24 icons of at most 256 KiB each. It skips hidden names, symlinks, node_modules, vendor, dist and release, and applies Git ignore rules when available. Results are best-effort, not an exhaustive inventory.
Effects: Mutations persist hierarchy changes; list and discovery return snapshots.
Recovery: Re-read the hierarchy before repeating an uncertain mutation.
HostRequest_hierarchy.name: HostRequest_hierarchy
HostRequest_hierarchy.title: HostRequest_hierarchy

HostRequest_home.description:
Usage: Get the host home directory.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: The returned path belongs to the host machine, not the browser.
Effects: Reads process environment state.
Recovery: Re-query after reconnecting to a host.
HostRequest_home.name: HostRequest_home
HostRequest_home.title: HostRequest_home

HostRequest_hostArtifactActivationStatus.description:
Usage: Read the outcome of a standalone host activation.
Inputs: Supply the original operation ID.
Invariants: State belongs to the daemon and the server relationship that requested the activation. A missing receipt does not prove that the operation ran or failed.
Effects: Reads durable state without installing, restarting or retrying.
Recovery: Poll after the link returns. If the outcome stays unknown, inspect the service and backup on the host before retrying.
HostRequest_hostArtifactActivationStatus.name: HostRequest_hostArtifactActivationStatus
HostRequest_hostArtifactActivationStatus.title: HostRequest_hostArtifactActivationStatus

HostRequest_hostInstalledBinaryDigests.description:
Usage: Read the SHA-256 digests of the managed standalone binaries.
Inputs: None.
Invariants: Only the authenticated current controller can read them. The daemon chooses both paths. A null runner digest means the managed runner is absent.
Effects: Reads the installed files on each request without changing them.
Recovery: Retry after reconnect, or inspect the managed binaries if they cannot be read.
HostRequest_hostInstalledBinaryDigests.name: HostRequest_hostInstalledBinaryDigests
HostRequest_hostInstalledBinaryDigests.title: HostRequest_hostInstalledBinaryDigests

HostRequest_hostSettingsGet.description:
Usage: Read this daemon's Keylime policy.
Inputs: None.
Invariants: Does not include environment or provider secrets.
Effects: Reads local policy.
Recovery: Retry on the same host after reconnect.
HostRequest_hostSettingsGet.name: HostRequest_hostSettingsGet
HostRequest_hostSettingsGet.title: HostRequest_hostSettingsGet

HostRequest_hostSettingsSet.description:
Usage: Patch this daemon's Keylime policy.
Inputs: Supply the fields to change; retention uses whole days or null to keep uploads.
Invariants: Settings do not propagate to any other host.
Effects: Saves locally and applies to subsequent daemon activity.
Recovery: Read back the host's policy after an uncertain reply.
HostRequest_hostSettingsSet.name: HostRequest_hostSettingsSet
HostRequest_hostSettingsSet.title: HostRequest_hostSettingsSet

HostRequest_inspectUploads.description:
Usage: Inspect upload destination conflicts.
Inputs: directory is a host path; names are destination basenames and owner supplies session context.
Invariants: Protected targets are rejected; nonReplaceable includes directories and symbolic links among conflicts.
Effects: Reads destination metadata without publishing files.
Recovery: Reinspect immediately before a decision; filesystem state can change.
HostRequest_inspectUploads.name: HostRequest_inspectUploads
HostRequest_inspectUploads.title: HostRequest_inspectUploads

HostRequest_invalidateSessionLists.description:
Usage: Invalidate session and workspace inventories.
Inputs: An optional path scopes the notification.
Invariants: Void success omits res.result in JSON.
Effects: Invalidates cached inventories and notifies linked servers.
Recovery: Refresh inventory after reconnect if notification delivery was uncertain.
HostRequest_invalidateSessionLists.name: HostRequest_invalidateSessionLists
HostRequest_invalidateSessionLists.title: HostRequest_invalidateSessionLists

HostRequest_listArchives.description:
Usage: List archived sessions.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Results are ordered newest first and represent a snapshot.
Effects: Reads archives without starting a runner.
Recovery: Refresh after archive or restore changes.
HostRequest_listArchives.name: HostRequest_listArchives
HostRequest_listArchives.title: HostRequest_listArchives

HostRequest_listFiles.description:
Usage: List a workspace directory.
Inputs: File request identifies the host path and optional session owner; showHidden controls hidden entries.
Invariants: The target must be a directory and access restrictions apply.
Effects: Reads a point-in-time filesystem listing.
Recovery: Refresh the listing after filesystem changes or reconnect.
HostRequest_listFiles.name: HostRequest_listFiles
HostRequest_listFiles.title: HostRequest_listFiles

HostRequest_listFilesInRoot.description:
Usage: List a directory confined to a root.
Inputs: File request selects a host path; root may be null.
Invariants: Paths outside an enforced root are rejected with outside_root.
Effects: Reads a filesystem listing.
Recovery: Correct the target or refresh after changes.
HostRequest_listFilesInRoot.name: HostRequest_listFilesInRoot
HostRequest_listFilesInRoot.title: HostRequest_listFilesInRoot

HostRequest_listProjects.description:
Usage: List the host project registry.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Raw entries include hidden projects and are a snapshot.
Effects: Reads registry data without starting a runner.
Recovery: Refresh after registry changes.
HostRequest_listProjects.name: HostRequest_listProjects
HostRequest_listProjects.title: HostRequest_listProjects

HostRequest_listSessionIdsForRestore.description:
Usage: Check active session IDs before restore.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: This strict inventory is uncached; failure cannot establish absence.
Effects: Reads active IDs without starting a runner.
Recovery: Resolve the failure and repeat the inventory before admitting restore.
HostRequest_listSessionIdsForRestore.name: HostRequest_listSessionIdsForRestore
HostRequest_listSessionIdsForRestore.title: HostRequest_listSessionIdsForRestore

HostRequest_listSessions.description:
Usage: List the host's sessions.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Inventory can be cached and is a snapshot.
Effects: Reads inventory without starting a runner.
Recovery: Refresh after invalidation or reconnect when a current list is needed.
HostRequest_listSessions.name: HostRequest_listSessions
HostRequest_listSessions.title: HostRequest_listSessions

HostRequest_listWorktrees.description:
Usage: List worktrees for a checkout.
Inputs: cwd is a host path.
Invariants: Results distinguish the main checkout and current worktree; branch may be null.
Effects: Reads Git worktree state.
Recovery: Refresh after worktrees or branches change.
HostRequest_listWorktrees.name: HostRequest_listWorktrees
HostRequest_listWorktrees.title: HostRequest_listWorktrees

HostRequest_modelsList.description:
Usage: Load the target daemon's model choices.
Inputs: Set refresh to rediscover models.
Invariants: Uses the daemon's OMP settings and credentials; returns no credential values.
Effects: Reads the host cache or queries the host's OMP runner.
Recovery: Retry on the same host, or inspect that host's OMP configuration.
HostRequest_modelsList.name: HostRequest_modelsList
HostRequest_modelsList.title: HostRequest_modelsList

HostRequest_open.description:
Usage: Join or start a runner.
Inputs: Provide session identity, launch settings and optional preparation or expected channel.
Invariants: Shared processes are joined, not replaced; trusted membership and startup fences apply. Cold startup can wait channelReadyMs plus opTimeoutMs.
Effects: Establishes membership; preparation protects a pending command across disconnects.
Recovery: Rejoin the expected channel after uncertainty rather than assuming a new process was started.
HostRequest_open.name: HostRequest_open
HostRequest_open.title: HostRequest_open

HostRequest_openBashOutput.description:
Usage: Open session bash output for chunked reading.
Inputs: sessionId and path identify the host output file.
Invariants: The returned reader refers to the opened file version.
Effects: Creates a reader handle; close it when finished.
Recovery: Reopen if the handle is lost or the file changes.
HostRequest_openBashOutput.name: HostRequest_openBashOutput
HostRequest_openBashOutput.title: HostRequest_openBashOutput

HostRequest_openFile.description:
Usage: Open a workspace file for chunked reading.
Inputs: File request identifies the host file and optional owner.
Invariants: The target must be a file; changes can invalidate the reader.
Effects: Allocates a host reader handle and returns its metadata.
Recovery: On file_changed, close and reopen instead of combining chunks from different versions.
HostRequest_openFile.name: HostRequest_openFile
HostRequest_openFile.title: HostRequest_openFile

HostRequest_planning.description:
Usage: Read or edit the Notes & Tasks board on its owning daemon.
Inputs: Identify a registered Repo or System by kind and ID, then select an action. Browser preview reads board references; Improve reads only live attachments on the selected task. Launch reads use the claimed launch ID and version, never arbitrary image IDs. Begin and launch updates are internal.
Invariants: Edits check the saved revision. Begin pins the generated name, saved prompt and task images, never Notes. Launch updates compare the full previous record. Only an unadmitted Effort that needs review can replace its setup plan.
Effects: Persists board changes outside the checkout. Preparing an older launch for delivery keeps only pinned images still proven to belong to its task. Does not write to Git or run workspace setup or chat delivery.
Recovery: Read the board after a conflict or uncertain result. Never assume an unconfirmed launch transition was claimed.
HostRequest_planning.name: HostRequest_planning
HostRequest_planning.title: HostRequest_planning

HostRequest_ptySessions.description:
Usage: List live session terminals on this host.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Includes idle PTYs, not just active turns.
Effects: None.
Recovery: Retry after the host reconnects.
HostRequest_ptySessions.name: HostRequest_ptySessions
HostRequest_ptySessions.title: HostRequest_ptySessions

HostRequest_publishUpload.description:
Usage: Publish a staged upload into a host directory.
Inputs: id identifies the staged upload; name, conflict strategy and optional owner select the destination.
Invariants: Protected targets are rejected and overwrite cannot replace directories or symbolic links.
Effects: Publishes, overwrites, or skips the target according to conflict strategy.
Recovery: upload_publish_uncertain means the outcome is indeterminate; inspect the target rather than blindly replaying.
HostRequest_publishUpload.name: HostRequest_publishUpload
HostRequest_publishUpload.title: HostRequest_publishUpload

HostRequest_readBashOutput.description:
Usage: Read a session bash output file.
Inputs: sessionId and path identify the session output on the host.
Invariants: Oversized output returns a size and byte limit instead of the contents.
Effects: Reads existing output without changing it.
Recovery: Use chunked output reading when the result is too large.
HostRequest_readBashOutput.name: HostRequest_readBashOutput
HostRequest_readBashOutput.title: HostRequest_readBashOutput

HostRequest_readClone.description:
Usage: Read incremental clone progress.
Inputs: id identifies the clone and cursor is a UTF-8 output byte position.
Invariants: reset signals that retained history no longer covers the requested cursor; terminal marks completion. Jobs expire after inactivity.
Effects: Reads retained progress frames and refreshes the job's idle timer.
Recovery: On reset replace the previous progress view; use the returned cursor for the next read.
HostRequest_readClone.name: HostRequest_readClone
HostRequest_readClone.title: HostRequest_readClone

HostRequest_readContext.description:
Usage: Read active context, entry boundary or paged history.
Inputs: Supply ID, optional leaf and context options including sync cursor and limit.
Invariants: The active branch and pre-compaction selection determine the snapshot; malformed, missing or oversized files fail.
Effects: Reads session data without starting a process.
Recovery: Refresh the cursor or correct the file before retrying; check the logical result separately from link success.
HostRequest_readContext.name: HostRequest_readContext
HostRequest_readContext.title: HostRequest_readContext

HostRequest_readFileChunk.description:
Usage: Read a chunk from an open file reader.
Inputs: id is the reader handle; offset and length are byte counts.
Invariants: Successful bytes travel in a binary host-link media frame, not a JSON Uint8Array.
Effects: Reads the open file without mutating it.
Recovery: If the file changed or the handle was lost, reopen and restart the read.
HostRequest_readFileChunk.name: HostRequest_readFileChunk
HostRequest_readFileChunk.title: HostRequest_readFileChunk

HostRequest_readMedia.description:
Usage: Read cached media.
Inputs: Supply a lowercase SHA-256 hash.
Invariants: The in-process value is Uint8Array; link transport uses a binary payload, not a JSON object.
Effects: Reads cached bytes without starting a runner.
Recovery: Resolve invalid hash or missing media before retrying.
HostRequest_readMedia.name: HostRequest_readMedia
HostRequest_readMedia.title: HostRequest_readMedia

HostRequest_readSession.description:
Usage: Read session metadata, navigation tree and display context.
Inputs: Supply session ID, deferred-content options, and optionally tail; before requires the previous historyRevision.
Invariants: Tail pages are chronological and exclusive on the active branch; continuation pages omit metadata and tree. Changed file generations or invalid branch cursors fail with session_history_changed. Without tail the full history is returned. This is not a live runner.
Effects: Reads session data without starting a process.
Recovery: Discard partial pages and synchronize after session_history_changed; inspect the logical operation result as well as the outer response.
HostRequest_readSession.name: HostRequest_readSession
HostRequest_readSession.title: HostRequest_readSession

HostRequest_readSessionState.description:
Usage: Read file-only session state.
Inputs: Supply session ID.
Invariants: The file-only result reports running false; it is not a live process query.
Effects: Reads session state without starting a runner.
Recovery: Resolve session_not_found before retrying.
HostRequest_readSessionState.name: HostRequest_readSessionState
HostRequest_readSessionState.title: HostRequest_readSessionState

HostRequest_readSubagentHistory.description:
Usage: Read subagent history from task results.
Inputs: Supply session ID.
Invariants: The session must exist; this is a snapshot.
Effects: Reads history without starting a runner.
Recovery: Refresh after task results change or resolve session_not_found.
HostRequest_readSubagentHistory.name: HostRequest_readSubagentHistory
HostRequest_readSubagentHistory.title: HostRequest_readSubagentHistory

HostRequest_readSubagentTranscript.description:
Usage: Read a subagent transcript page or completion artifact.
Inputs: Supply session ID, subagent ID, mode and byte cursor.
Invariants: Page offsets are bytes; reset signals a changed transcript. The session and transcript must exist.
Effects: Reads artifacts without starting a runner.
Recovery: Honor reset and restart paging; correct missing or invalid identifiers.
HostRequest_readSubagentTranscript.name: HostRequest_readSubagentTranscript
HostRequest_readSubagentTranscript.title: HostRequest_readSubagentTranscript

HostRequest_readTextFile.description:
Usage: Read a workspace text file.
Inputs: File request identifies a host file and optional owner.
Invariants: Access and file restrictions apply; returned size is in bytes.
Effects: Reads file content and metadata.
Recovery: Re-read after a change; the result is not a subscription.
HostRequest_readTextFile.name: HostRequest_readTextFile
HostRequest_readTextFile.title: HostRequest_readTextFile

HostRequest_readThinking.description:
Usage: Read an assistant thinking block.
Inputs: Supply session ID, entry ID and block index.
Invariants: Session, assistant entry and block must exist.
Effects: Reads the session file without starting a runner.
Recovery: Refresh session context if the entry or block is absent.
HostRequest_readThinking.name: HostRequest_readThinking
HostRequest_readThinking.title: HostRequest_readThinking

HostRequest_removeRegisteredWorktree.description:
Usage: Remove a registered worktree.
Inputs: Host project and worktree paths plus stopProcesses, discardChanges, keepBranch and cancel control admission.
Invariants: Unregistered projects are rejected; processes, dirty changes and branch decisions can require confirmation.
Effects: Accepted removal can stop processes, discard changes, remove the worktree and delete its branch.
Recovery: Inspect returned status and current hierarchy/Git state before retrying an uncertain removal.
HostRequest_removeRegisteredWorktree.name: HostRequest_removeRegisteredWorktree
HostRequest_removeRegisteredWorktree.title: HostRequest_removeRegisteredWorktree

HostRequest_renameSessionFile.description:
Usage: Rename a session file.
Inputs: Supply session ID, title and optional title source.
Invariants: The target session must exist.
Effects: Mutates the session title on disk.
Recovery: Read the title after an uncertain response before repeating the mutation.
HostRequest_renameSessionFile.name: HostRequest_renameSessionFile
HostRequest_renameSessionFile.title: HostRequest_renameSessionFile

HostRequest_resolveLocalFile.description:
Usage: Resolve a local:// session file without reading it.
Inputs: id identifies the session, uri is the local URI and sessionFile is nullable context.
Invariants: Resolution and access restrictions are evaluated on the host.
Effects: Returns a host path without reading file contents.
Recovery: Resolve again if the session or file context changes.
HostRequest_resolveLocalFile.name: HostRequest_resolveLocalFile
HostRequest_resolveLocalFile.title: HostRequest_resolveLocalFile

HostRequest_restoreArchive.description:
Usage: Restore an archive under a reserved claim.
Inputs: Supply archive key and claim.
Invariants: The claim must be reserved and unfenced in this daemon instance.
Effects: Restores archived session data.
Recovery: Fence and reconcile the answering instance after uncertainty; unresolved prior-instance authority requires manual recovery rather than assuming expiry.
HostRequest_restoreArchive.name: HostRequest_restoreArchive
HostRequest_restoreArchive.title: HostRequest_restoreArchive

HostRequest_restoreFence.description:
Usage: Fence a restore claim.
Inputs: Supply a nonempty claim.
Invariants: Running refers only to the answering daemon instance; its identity is returned.
Effects: Revokes admission for that claim in that instance.
Recovery: Compare instance identity; a replacement daemon cannot establish whether work in the previous instance stopped.
HostRequest_restoreFence.name: HostRequest_restoreFence
HostRequest_restoreFence.title: HostRequest_restoreFence

HostRequest_restoreReserve.description:
Usage: Reserve a restore claim.
Inputs: Supply a nonempty claim.
Invariants: The returned instance identifies the daemon holding the reservation; claims are not expiring leases. At most 256 reservations are retained; the oldest is evicted.
Effects: Reserves admission in this daemon instance.
Recovery: Retain instance identity and fence the claim after uncertainty; a different instance cannot prove the old instance stopped.
HostRequest_restoreReserve.name: HostRequest_restoreReserve
HostRequest_restoreReserve.title: HostRequest_restoreReserve

HostRequest_sessionFileExists.description:
Usage: Check whether a session transcript exists.
Inputs: Supply its daemon-local path.
Invariants: Paths outside session roots are refused.
Effects: Reads the filesystem; no process is started.
Recovery: Correct the path or restore access before retrying a failed check.
HostRequest_sessionFileExists.name: HostRequest_sessionFileExists
HostRequest_sessionFileExists.title: HostRequest_sessionFileExists

HostRequest_shipFinish.description:
Usage: Start finishing a shipped workspace.
Inputs: projectPath and path identify registered host checkouts.
Invariants: Cleanup requires a merged PR bound to the current registered workspace ID. Path reuse and records without an ID are refused; earlier steps may already have completed on failure.
Effects: May update the base checkout, archive sessions and remove the workspace.
Recovery: Read job and checkout state before retrying an uncertain finish.
HostRequest_shipFinish.name: HostRequest_shipFinish
HostRequest_shipFinish.title: HostRequest_shipFinish

HostRequest_shipMonitorStatus.description:
Usage: Read the current PR feedback watch before admitting a digest.
Inputs: projectPath, path and monitorId identify the exact workspace and monitor generation.
Invariants: Returns a watch only to its initiating server when the recorded PR is open and the chat is still active in the workspace. The PR URL is canonical.
Effects: Reads local state without changing or caching the watch.
Recovery: A missing watch cannot authorize a digest. Recheck on the next offer.
HostRequest_shipMonitorStatus.name: HostRequest_shipMonitorStatus
HostRequest_shipMonitorStatus.title: HostRequest_shipMonitorStatus

HostRequest_shipPreview.description:
Usage: Preview shipping a registered workspace against its base checkout.
Inputs: projectPath and path are host filesystem paths.
Invariants: Dirty state, branch divergence, issues and PR data are point-in-time observations; GitHub authentication status is briefly cached.
Effects: Inspects Git and GitHub without starting a ship job.
Recovery: Refresh the preview after state changes; it does not reserve the checkout.
HostRequest_shipPreview.name: HostRequest_shipPreview
HostRequest_shipPreview.title: HostRequest_shipPreview

HostRequest_shipStatus.description:
Usage: Read a ship job by id.
Inputs: id identifies the host job.
Invariants: Status and ordered steps report persisted progress, not an atomic transaction.
Effects: Reads job state; recovery marks jobs interrupted after restart.
Recovery: Inspect steps and repository/PR state before deciding how to proceed.
HostRequest_shipStatus.name: HostRequest_shipStatus
HostRequest_shipStatus.title: HostRequest_shipStatus

HostRequest_stageHostArtifact.description:
Usage: Stage a binary, runner or other artifact for manual installation.
Inputs: Supply the ID of a completed upload on this link.
Invariants: The upload must be nonempty and unused by a session or workspace. The daemon picks the destination; it never overwrites an artifact or an installed binary.
Effects: Moves the file into private host staging without execute permission and returns its host-local path. It does not install, start or restart anything.
Recovery: If confirmation is lost, inspect keylime/host-artifacts/<upload id> under the daemon's agent directory before uploading again.
HostRequest_stageHostArtifact.name: HostRequest_stageHostArtifact
HostRequest_stageHostArtifact.title: HostRequest_stageHostArtifact

HostRequest_startClone.description:
Usage: Start cloning a repository into a host directory.
Inputs: id identifies the clone; parent is a host path and url is the Git remote.
Invariants: The target directory derives from the supported remote URL; progress is asynchronous.
Effects: Starts Git and creates files in the target directory; jobs survive web/link restart but not daemon shutdown or prolonged inactivity.
Recovery: Read clone progress and inspect the target after uncertainty; do not blindly start another clone.
HostRequest_startClone.name: HostRequest_startClone
HostRequest_startClone.title: HostRequest_startClone

HostRequest_startShip.description:
Usage: Start the asynchronous ship sequence for a registered workspace.
Inputs: Host project/workspace paths, mode, rebase, PR and cleanup choices control the sequence. For monitoring in PR modes, pass both monitorSessionId for a chat in the same workspace and the server-issued monitorGrantId.
Invariants: Checkout and branch preconditions are checked during execution; steps can fail after earlier steps succeeded. The authenticated daemon link selects the notification server. Job acceptance does not mean monitoring has started.
Effects: Depending on mode, rebases, fast-forwards, pushes, creates or configures a PR, and may archive sessions and remove the workspace. Opted-in monitoring sends feedback links to chat without gating merges.
Recovery: Inspect job status and Git/PR state after uncertainty; do not blindly replay destructive steps.
HostRequest_startShip.name: HostRequest_startShip
HostRequest_startShip.title: HostRequest_startShip

HostRequest_startShipMonitor.description:
Usage: Watch an already recorded open PR without running Ship.
Inputs: projectPath and path identify the workspace. Pass the expected canonical prUrl, a chat sessionId in this workspace, and a server-issued monitorId.
Invariants: The authenticated link selects the notification server. The host checks that the recorded PR belongs to the current workspace ID and checks the chat; it never replaces an existing watch.
Effects: Starts feedback monitoring without changing the PR or merge settings.
Recovery: Refresh the workspace hierarchy before retrying an uncertain start.
HostRequest_startShipMonitor.name: HostRequest_startShipMonitor
HostRequest_startShipMonitor.title: HostRequest_startShipMonitor

HostRequest_stopShipMonitor.description:
Usage: Stop PR feedback monitoring for a workspace.
Inputs: projectPath, path and monitorId identify a workspace and monitor generation.
Invariants: Only the initiating server link can stop a monitor. A stale generation cannot stop its replacement.
Effects: Stops feedback monitoring without changing the pull request or merge settings.
Recovery: Refresh workspace state before retrying an uncertain request.
HostRequest_stopShipMonitor.name: HostRequest_stopShipMonitor
HostRequest_stopShipMonitor.title: HostRequest_stopShipMonitor

HostRequest_systems.description:
Usage: Manage Systems and Efforts on one host daemon.
Inputs: Select an action with its host paths, IDs, settings, or preview confirmation. Service controls identify a saved service and never take a command or environment override.
Invariants: Creation captures resolved commits and the System definition. Planned admission requires the daemon's current launch version and plan. Paths and branches remain stable on rename. A running service is not a readiness check.
Effects: Actions can change definitions, admit durable setup, control daemon-owned service PTYs, or clean up Efforts. Cleanup does not remove branches, push commits, or close PRs.
Recovery: List host state after uncertain delivery. Retry incomplete setup explicitly and refresh a cleanup preview before resuming removal. A daemon restart does not restart services.
HostRequest_systems.name: HostRequest_systems
HostRequest_systems.title: HostRequest_systems

HostRequest_terminals.description:
Usage: Manage host-daemon terminals for a workspace.
Inputs: The action selects cwd, terminal id, dimensions, input text, or viewer focus state.
Invariants: IDs and snapshots belong to the daemon; cursors order output, not filesystem bytes. A service terminal can retain output after its process exits.
Effects: Create starts an interactive login shell using the host account's shell, falling back to the daemon's SHELL or /bin/sh when unavailable; it inherits the daemon's HOME when set. Input, resize, focus and close change terminal state; list and snapshot observe it.
Recovery: Re-list or snapshot after disconnection; a restarted daemon does not preserve terminal processes.
HostRequest_terminals.name: HostRequest_terminals
HostRequest_terminals.title: HostRequest_terminals

HostRequest_unwatchFile.description:
Usage: Stop a file watch.
Inputs: id and epoch identify the watch instance.
Invariants: Epoch distinguishes a watch from later reuse of the same id.
Effects: Releases that watch and its event stream.
Recovery: After reconnect, establish a fresh watch and snapshot.
HostRequest_unwatchFile.name: HostRequest_unwatchFile
HostRequest_unwatchFile.title: HostRequest_unwatchFile

HostRequest_updateProject.description:
Usage: Apply project presentation updates.
Inputs: Supply updates with cwd and optional nullable fields.
Invariants: Duplicate targets merge per field, with later defined values winning; hidden entries are untouched. Invalid new paths in a bulk update can be skipped, while an entirely invalid batch fails. newRoots identifies newly registered roots.
Effects: Mutates registry entries in one save.
Recovery: Read the registry after uncertain delivery before repeating.
HostRequest_updateProject.name: HostRequest_updateProject
HostRequest_updateProject.title: HostRequest_updateProject

HostRequest_uploadAbort.description:
Usage: Cancel a staged upload.
Inputs: Supply its UUID.
Invariants: Upload controls are ordered per upload; an earlier attach cannot undo cancellation.
Effects: Aborts staged data owned by this link; void success omits res.result.
Recovery: Reconcile upload state after a lost response before proceeding.
HostRequest_uploadAbort.name: HostRequest_uploadAbort
HostRequest_uploadAbort.title: HostRequest_uploadAbort

HostRequest_uploadAttach.description:
Usage: Attach a completed staged upload to a session.
Inputs: Supply upload ID and daemon-local session identity and file.
Invariants: The retained generation must exist; existing names are not overwritten. Repeating for the same destination is idempotent only while its receipt target exists, but a different consumed destination is 404.
Effects: Installs the file under local/uploads, choosing another name on collision; cross-device copies may take ten minutes.
Recovery: Retry the same destination after an uncertain response, not a different destination.
HostRequest_uploadAttach.name: HostRequest_uploadAttach
HostRequest_uploadAttach.title: HostRequest_uploadAttach

HostRequest_uploadStart.description:
Usage: Create or resume a staged upload.
Inputs: Supply upload ID, attempt generation, name, MIME type and byte size; binary pieces follow separately.
Invariants: Reusing an ID with different metadata conflicts; acknowledgements are attempt-bound. Completed attachment receipts require the retained target to exist, not merely a stored receipt.
Effects: Creates or resumes daemon-local staged data; inactive staged files are swept after 24 hours.
Recovery: Resume with matching metadata and use the acknowledged offset, not stale attempt acknowledgements.
HostRequest_uploadStart.name: HostRequest_uploadStart
HostRequest_uploadStart.title: HostRequest_uploadStart

HostRequest_usageReport.description:
Usage: Report token usage and estimated costs on the selected daemon.
Inputs: Supply optional date, granularity and project filters, or request a refresh.
Invariants: Requires canReportUsage; aggregates only this daemon's transcripts, and costs are not an authoritative provider bill.
Effects: Reads transcripts and synchronizes the daemon's usage database. Refresh invalidates local caches.
Recovery: Reconnect or upgrade the selected daemon and retry on the same host.
HostRequest_usageReport.name: HostRequest_usageReport
HostRequest_usageReport.title: HostRequest_usageReport

HostRequest_validateCwd.description:
Usage: Validate a working directory and resolve its project.
Inputs: Supply a daemon-local path.
Invariants: Missing paths and non-directories fail.
Effects: Reads filesystem and project information without starting a runner.
Recovery: Correct the path or filesystem state before retrying.
HostRequest_validateCwd.name: HostRequest_validateCwd
HostRequest_validateCwd.title: HostRequest_validateCwd

HostRequest_watchFile.description:
Usage: Watch a workspace file and obtain initial metadata.
Inputs: id, epoch and file request identify the watch instance and host file.
Invariants: The target must be a file; epoch distinguishes successive watches, and startup can return watch_closed.
Effects: Registers a watch that emits file events until closed or disconnected.
Recovery: Reopen with a fresh epoch and refresh metadata after disconnection.
HostRequest_watchFile.name: HostRequest_watchFile
HostRequest_watchFile.title: HostRequest_watchFile

HostRequest_workspaceBranches.description:
Usage: List branch choices for workspace creation.
Inputs: projectPath is a registered host project path.
Invariants: The local default is preferred; origin's default is a second choice only when it has commits missing locally. Other choices exclude checked-out branches. GitHub pull requests include drafts.
Effects: Refreshes remote-tracking refs and queries GitHub if configured, without creating a branch or checkout.
Recovery: Reopen the picker to refresh refs; a remote that couldn't be refreshed uses cached refs.
HostRequest_workspaceBranches.name: HostRequest_workspaceBranches
HostRequest_workspaceBranches.title: HostRequest_workspaceBranches

HostRequest_workspaceCreationSettings.description:
Usage: Read or update workspace creation settings.
Inputs: Optional projectPath selects project settings; omitted fields remain unchanged and null override clears it.
Invariants: Defaults, override and source determine the effective creation pipeline.
Effects: Supplied settings are persisted; a read returns the current settings.
Recovery: Re-read settings after an uncertain update before making another change.
HostRequest_workspaceCreationSettings.name: HostRequest_workspaceCreationSettings
HostRequest_workspaceCreationSettings.title: HostRequest_workspaceCreationSettings

HostRequest_workspaceCreationStatus.description:
Usage: Read an asynchronous creation job.
Inputs: id identifies the host job.
Invariants: Stage, status and logs describe recorded progress; interrupted is distinct from failure.
Effects: Observes job state, including recovery of interrupted work.
Recovery: Inspect the job and workspace before restarting creation.
HostRequest_workspaceCreationStatus.name: HostRequest_workspaceCreationStatus
HostRequest_workspaceCreationStatus.title: HostRequest_workspaceCreationStatus
