anyOf.description:
Usage: Read the runner's current planning state and pending review.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: The proposal is present only while awaiting a decision.
Effects: None.
Recovery: Refresh after reconnect or an uncertain decision.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_get_plan_state

anyOf.description:
Usage: Enter Plan mode or manually return to Build mode.
Inputs: enabled selects Plan when true, Build when false.
Invariants: Manual exit restores write access without approving a proposal. Entering during a turn steers in plan context; a different plan model takes effect after that turn.
Effects: Changes native planning state and may change the model and reasoning effort.
Recovery: Read planning state after an uncertain response.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_set_plan_mode

anyOf.description:
Usage: Approve a pending plan or request revisions.
Inputs: Supply the current proposal id, approval choice and optional feedback.
Invariants: A stale proposal id cannot decide another review; revision retains Plan mode. Approval stops the planning turn and restores the pre-plan model and effort before execution.
Effects: Approval starts an implementation turn; revision returns feedback to the planner.
Recovery: Read planning state and the transcript before retrying an uncertain decision; do not repeat an approved implementation turn.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_respond_plan_proposal

anyOf.description:
Usage: List the session's live managed Chromium tabs.
Inputs: None.
Invariants: Only tabs owned by this session are returned; ids identify exact CDP targets.
Effects: None; this does not start or change a browser.
Recovery: List again when a tab closes or is replaced.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_browser_list

anyOf.description:
Usage: Capture a view-only image of a session-owned Chromium tab.
Inputs: Provide the exact target id returned by browser_list.
Invariants: Ownership and target identity are checked at capture time; the image is bounded JPEG data encoded as base64.
Effects: Reads the visible page without input or browser lifecycle changes.
Recovery: List tabs again if the target is unavailable.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_browser_capture

anyOf.description:
Usage: Start encoded video for a session-owned tab.
Inputs: Supply the exact discovered target id.
Invariants: Ownership is checked and no CDP endpoint is exposed.
Effects: Starts an ephemeral bounded video stream.
Recovery: Stop when hidden and start again after disconnect.

args.description: Start an ephemeral video lease for this session-owned tab.

anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_browser_video_start

anyOf.description:
Usage: Pull encoded packets from an active video stream.
Inputs: Supply its target id and stream id.
Invariants: Packets are bounded and ephemeral; ownership is rechecked.
Effects: Consumes queued packets.
Recovery: Restart the stream after an error or decoder failure.

args.description: Read or release a video lease for its exact session-owned tab.

anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_browser_video_next

anyOf.description:
Usage: Stop an encoded video stream.
Inputs: Supply its target id and stream id.
Invariants: Only the owning session can stop the stream.
Effects: Releases video resources.
Recovery: Streams expire when the viewer disconnects.

args.description: Read or release a video lease for its exact session-owned tab.

anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_browser_video_stop

anyOf.description:
Usage: Send a bounded ordered batch of navigation or input actions to a session-owned Chromium tab.
Inputs: Provide the exact target id and 1–64 browser control actions in delivery order; navigation accepts HTTP or HTTPS URLs.
Invariants: The entire batch is validated before dispatch. Ownership and exact target identity are rechecked before each action; coordinates use the captured visual viewport in CSS pixels. No exclusive control or agent lock is established.
Effects: Sequentially delivers navigation, mouse, wheel, keyboard, text, or touch input through one CDP session. A failure stops the batch and may leave an applied prefix.
Recovery: A timeout or disconnect leaves partial delivery uncertain; never replay the batch or its remaining actions automatically.

args.description: A bounded ordered batch addressed to one exact session-owned Chromium target. HTTP request bodies are limited to 1 MiB. No atomicity or exclusive control against other viewers or the agent is promised.

actions.description: Actions applied sequentially in array order after whole-batch validation. Ownership is rechecked before each action. Failure may leave an applied prefix; never retry the batch automatically.

buttons.description: Pressed mouse buttons as the DOM/CDP bitmask: left 1, right 2, middle 4, back 8, forward 16.

modifiers.description: CDP modifier bitmask: Alt 1, Ctrl 2, Meta 4, Shift 8.
CDP modifier bitmask: Alt 1, Ctrl 2, Meta 4, Shift 8.
CDP modifier bitmask: Alt 1, Ctrl 2, Meta 4, Shift 8.
CDP modifier bitmask: Alt 1, Ctrl 2, Meta 4, Shift 8.

items.description: A single browser navigation or input action. Coordinates are visual viewport CSS pixels; touch points are the contacts remaining after the event.

anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_browser_control

anyOf.description:
Usage: Submit user input to the session.
Inputs: Provide message and optional images, clientMessageId and streamingBehavior.
Invariants: The reply acknowledges admission, not completion; local builtins can report agentInvoked without a normal agent turn. A clientMessageId is unique within the session's correlation journal, not a global retry key.
Effects: Runs input hooks and may enqueue or start an agent turn.
Recovery: Reconcile an uncertain correlated submission with get_client_message_status; observe prompt result and settled state separately.

clientMessageId.description: Session-scoped correlation identity; use status reconciliation after uncertain delivery.

images.description: Optional inline image content accompanying the input.

data.description: Base64-encoded image data.

mimeType.description: Image media type.

message.description: User input text submitted to the session.

anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_prompt

anyOf.description:
Usage: Record text as the first user message of a new task chat.
Inputs: Provide the exact nonblank Brief and optional inline images. Preserve whitespace, slash prefixes and image order.
Invariants: Only an idle chat without user messages or queued input can accept it. Input hooks, slash commands and template expansion do not run. Success confirms the first user message was saved, not that the model completed a turn.
Effects: Submits literal user text through OMP's native input queue and waits for transcript persistence.
Recovery: For literal_delivery_unknown, a timeout or a lost reply, check the linked chat and never resend automatically.

images.description: Optional inline image content accompanying the input.

data.description: Base64-encoded image data.

mimeType.description: Image media type.

message.description: User input text submitted to the session.

anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_prompt_literal

anyOf.description:
Usage: Steer the current run.
Inputs: Provide message, optional images and clientMessageId.
Invariants: Admission is ordered with other user input; acknowledgement is not turn completion.
Effects: Delivers or queues steering input after input hooks.
Recovery: Reconcile an uncertain correlated input before sending another.

clientMessageId.description: Session-scoped correlation identity; use status reconciliation after uncertain delivery.

images.description: Optional inline image content accompanying the input.

data.description: Base64-encoded image data.

mimeType.description: Image media type.

message.description: User input text submitted to the session.

anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_steer

anyOf.description:
Usage: Enqueue follow-up input.
Inputs: Provide message, optional images and clientMessageId.
Invariants: Acknowledgement follows admission, not completion; the queue is session state.
Effects: Adds follow-up input for the agent.
Recovery: Reconcile an uncertain correlated input and inspect the queue before resubmitting.

clientMessageId.description: Session-scoped correlation identity; use status reconciliation after uncertain delivery.

images.description: Optional inline image content accompanying the input.

data.description: Base64-encoded image data.

mimeType.description: Image media type.

message.description: User input text submitted to the session.

anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_follow_up

anyOf.description:
Usage: Remove a matching queued message.
Inputs: Supply message text and steering or followUp queue.
Invariants: The result says whether a match was found and includes its images when present.
Effects: Removes the matching queued input.
Recovery: Inspect the queue after an uncertain response before removing again.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_remove_queued_message

anyOf.description:
Usage: Promote a queued message.
Inputs: Supply its message text.
Invariants: The result reports whether a match was promoted.
Effects: Changes the queued message's priority.
Recovery: Inspect the queue after an uncertain response.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_promote_queued_message

anyOf.description:
Usage: Abort the active run and pending input.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Cancellation does not undo already completed side effects.
Effects: Stops goal continuation and builtin work, voids queued input and aborts the run.
Recovery: Inspect state and transcript after uncertainty; recover editor input separately.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_abort

anyOf.description:
Usage: Abort and recover queued input for an editor.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Queue entries are withdrawn before abort so the interrupted run cannot consume them.
Effects: Stops the run and returns steering and follow-up messages; prior effects are not rolled back.
Recovery: Restore the returned messages in the editor; inspect session state if the response was lost.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_abort_and_restore_queue

anyOf.description:
Usage: Abort the current run and submit replacement input asynchronously.
Inputs: Provide message, optional images and clientMessageId.
Invariants: The reply follows abort but may precede replacement admission; later dispatch errors arrive as prompt_error and prompt_result.
Effects: Stops the active run and schedules replacement input; completed side effects are not undone.
Recovery: Reconcile the clientMessageId and observe prompt_result after uncertainty before resending.

clientMessageId.description: Session-scoped correlation identity; use status reconciliation after uncertain delivery.

images.description: Optional inline image content accompanying the input.

data.description: Base64-encoded image data.

mimeType.description: Image media type.

message.description: User input text submitted to the session.

anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_abort_and_prompt

anyOf.description:
Usage: Set steering queue mode.
Inputs: mode is all or one-at-a-time.
Invariants: The setting is session-only and is not persisted.
Effects: Changes how steering messages are consumed.
Recovery: Read state and reapply the desired mode after restart.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_set_steering_mode

anyOf.description:
Usage: Set follow-up queue mode.
Inputs: mode is all or one-at-a-time.
Invariants: The setting is session-only and is not persisted.
Effects: Changes how follow-up messages are consumed.
Recovery: Read state and reapply the desired mode after restart.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_set_follow_up_mode

anyOf.description:
Usage: Set interrupt mode.
Inputs: mode is immediate or wait.
Invariants: The setting is session-only and is not persisted.
Effects: Changes how the session handles interruptions.
Recovery: Read state and reapply the desired mode after restart.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_set_interrupt_mode

anyOf.description:
Usage: Compact the current session with an OMP handoff summary.
Inputs: Optional string customInstructions guides the summary.
Invariants: Compaction runs in the background without interrupting an active response. OMP rejects overlapping compaction or a session transition.
Effects: Updates the current session's context, not a separate session. The runner waits for compaction to finish before replying with {}; compaction errors fail the command.
Recovery: If delivery is uncertain, inspect session state and manual_compaction_end before retrying.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_handoff

anyOf.description:
Usage: Read or control the session goal.
Inputs: Select get, create, resume, pause or drop; objective and token_budget are optional operation inputs.
Invariants: Goal state belongs to the current session; operations have different state preconditions.
Effects: Mutating operations change goal continuation state.
Recovery: Read the goal before retrying an uncertain mutation.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_goal

anyOf.description:
Usage: Replace session todo phases.
Inputs: Supply the complete phases array with tasks and statuses.
Invariants: This replaces rather than patches the existing phases.
Effects: Commits the supplied todo state and returns the resulting phases.
Recovery: Read session state after uncertainty before replacing again.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_set_todos

anyOf.description:
Usage: Execute a shell command while streaming bash_output frames.
Inputs: Supply command and optionally excludeFromContext.
Invariants: Output frames are incremental; the result follows execution.
Effects: Runs a shell command with its ordinary filesystem and process side effects.
Recovery: Inspect external state after uncertainty; rerunning a shell command may duplicate side effects.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_bash

anyOf.description:
Usage: Abort the active shell command.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Aborting cannot undo effects the command already made.
Effects: Signals the shell execution to stop.
Recovery: Inspect shell result and external state after uncertainty.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_abort_bash

anyOf.description:
Usage: Recover correlation for one to 32 unique client message IDs.
Inputs: Supply unique nonempty IDs up to 128 characters each.
Invariants: Status reflects this session's in-flight and journaled input; bounded responses can omit oversized native messages.
Effects: Reads correlation state without submitting input.
Recovery: Use session history when messages are omitted; do not treat an uncertain transport as proof of non-admission.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_get_client_message_status

anyOf.description:
Usage: Read live session state.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: This is a current in-process snapshot, not a durable history or completion guarantee; model metadata excludes host-local provider credentials and headers.
Effects: Reads model, queue, goal, tools and activity state without submitting work.
Recovery: Refresh after reconnecting or when state changes.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_get_state

anyOf.description:
Usage: Select an exact provider and model for this session.
Inputs: Supply both provider and modelId.
Invariants: A miss waits for background discovery and refreshes that provider on the session's host before failing; the result excludes host-local provider credentials and headers.
Effects: Changes the active session model.
Recovery: Read state or available models after an uncertain response before selecting again.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_set_model

anyOf.description:
Usage: Apply a configured chat role to the live session.
Inputs: Supply a known chat role ID.
Invariants: Resolves against the full available registry using OMP's role cycle, independently of enabledModels; unavailable roles fail.
Effects: Applies OMP's session role marker, model and explicit role thinking without changing settings.
Recovery: Read session state after an uncertain response before applying again.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_set_chat_role

anyOf.description:
Usage: Cycle the available session models.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Result may be null; isScoped reports whether selection used the configured model scope.
Effects: Selects the next model when available.
Recovery: Read current state after uncertainty rather than cycling again blindly.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_cycle_model

anyOf.description:
Usage: Resolve workspace chat roles.
Inputs: Optionally supply the current composer thinking selector, whether an unconfigured default may use the runner model, and a current provider/model ID pair for a temporary runner.
Invariants: Uses native OMP role-cycle resolution and the full available registry; the supplied selector only affects the preview.
Effects: Waits for model discovery.
Recovery: Check workspace settings and provider configuration.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_get_chat_roles

anyOf.description:
Usage: List currently available models.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Waits for background discovery; results reflect the current registry.
Effects: Reads model availability without selecting a model.
Recovery: Refresh after discovery or provider configuration changes.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_get_available_models

anyOf.description:
Usage: Refresh and list available models from configured providers.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Waits for background discovery and serializes explicit registry refreshes; the session and active run remain alive. Discovery and configuration failures reject the command.
Effects: Bypasses discovery caches, refreshes command-backed credentials and updates the live registry and model scope.
Recovery: Check provider configuration and retry after a failure.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_refresh_available_models

anyOf.description:
Usage: Set the thinking level.
Inputs: Supply level.
Invariants: Valid levels depend on the configured model.
Effects: Changes the session thinking setting.
Recovery: Read state after uncertainty before reapplying.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_set_thinking_level

anyOf.description:
Usage: Cycle available thinking levels.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Null means no level was selected.
Effects: Changes the current thinking level when possible.
Recovery: Read state after uncertainty rather than cycling again blindly.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_cycle_thinking_level

anyOf.description:
Usage: List available thinking levels.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Levels reflect the current session model.
Effects: Reads the live model configuration without changing it.
Recovery: Refresh after changing models.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_get_available_thinking_levels

anyOf.description:
Usage: Read the automatic prewalk mode for this live session.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Native session state or plan mode can suppress classification; a native judge is required.
Effects: Reads the session's effective native setting without changing the model.
Recovery: Read again after changing settings.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_get_auto_prewalk

anyOf.description:
Usage: Override automatic prewalk for this live session.
Inputs: mode is off, suggest or on.
Invariants: Native session state or plan mode can suppress classification; a native judge is required. The override is lost when the runner exits.
Effects: Changes only the live session setting; never writes native configuration or selects a model.
Recovery: Read the session mode after an uncertain response.

args.description: Requested session-local automatic prewalk mode.

mode.description: Native automatic prewalk mode for task classification and handoff.

anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_set_auto_prewalk

anyOf.description:
Usage: Set fast mode.
Inputs: Supply enabled.
Invariants: Enabled and active are distinct: the current model determines whether fast mode is active.
Effects: Changes the session fast-mode setting.
Recovery: Read state after uncertainty before reapplying.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_set_fast_mode

anyOf.description:
Usage: Set slow mode.
Inputs: Supply enabled.
Invariants: Support and scope depend on the current session model.
Effects: Changes the slow-mode setting and returns its effective enabled state.
Recovery: Read state after uncertainty before reapplying.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_set_slow_mode

anyOf.description:
Usage: Configure automatic compaction.
Inputs: Supply enabled.
Invariants: This changes the setting, not an existing compaction result.
Effects: Enables or disables future automatic compaction.
Recovery: Read session state after uncertainty.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_set_auto_compaction

anyOf.description:
Usage: Configure automatic retry.
Inputs: Supply enabled.
Invariants: This is separate from aborting a pending retry.
Effects: Enables or disables future automatic retries.
Recovery: Inspect current configuration after uncertainty.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_set_auto_retry

anyOf.description:
Usage: Abort a pending retry.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Already completed work is not rolled back.
Effects: Signals the pending retry to stop.
Recovery: Inspect session activity after uncertainty.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_abort_retry

anyOf.description:
Usage: Set cache warming mode.
Inputs: mode is off, streaming or idle.
Invariants: The returned mode is the effective setting.
Effects: Changes the session cache warmer configuration.
Recovery: Inspect the current setting after uncertainty.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_set_cache_warming

anyOf.description:
Usage: Compact session context.
Inputs: customInstructions may be omitted.
Invariants: Compaction may be aborted and is not a transcript deletion guarantee.
Effects: Produces and persists a compacted context summary.
Recovery: Inspect session state and history after uncertainty before compacting again.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_compact

anyOf.description:
Usage: Abort in-flight compaction.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: This requests cancellation rather than reversing a completed compaction.
Effects: Signals the compaction operation to stop.
Recovery: Inspect compaction state and history after uncertainty.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_abort_compaction

anyOf.description:
Usage: Generate a session title.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: The title may be null when none is generated.
Effects: Persists a generated title when available.
Recovery: Inspect the session name after uncertainty before generating again.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_generate_title

anyOf.description:
Usage: Read session usage statistics.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Statistics describe the current session snapshot.
Effects: Reads usage without changing the session.
Recovery: Refresh after further activity.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_get_session_stats

anyOf.description:
Usage: List available slash commands.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: The list reflects current session capabilities.
Effects: Reads the current command registry.
Recovery: Refresh after extensions or session configuration change.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_get_available_commands

anyOf.description:
Usage: Create a session, optionally linked to a parent.
Inputs: parentSession may be omitted.
Invariants: A cancelled change does not detach the current run.
Effects: On success switches the process to the new session.
Recovery: Inspect current identity after uncertainty before creating another session.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_new_session

anyOf.description:
Usage: Switch to a session file.
Inputs: Supply sessionPath and optionally both provider and modelId.
Invariants: A cancelled switch leaves the current session in place.
Effects: On success changes session and may detach a live run.
Recovery: Inspect current identity after uncertainty before switching again.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_switch_session

anyOf.description:
Usage: Resume the newest nonempty session in a directory or create one.
Inputs: Supply sessionDir and optionally both provider and modelId.
Invariants: Session persistence is required; reopening the active session does not detach its live run.
Effects: May switch or create a session and select its model.
Recovery: Inspect returned identity or current state after uncertainty before reopening.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_open_session

anyOf.description:
Usage: Fork a session snapshot at an optional entry.
Inputs: entryId may be omitted.
Invariants: The session must be idle for a consistent snapshot; idleness is rechecked after awaits.
Effects: Switches to the fork unless cancelled.
Recovery: Inspect current session identity after uncertainty; retry session_busy only once work has settled.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_fork

anyOf.description:
Usage: Branch from a user entry.
Inputs: Supply entryId.
Invariants: Branching differs from editing the current history leaf; a live run continues normally.
Effects: Changes session branch and returns selected text unless cancelled.
Recovery: Inspect session identity and tree before repeating an uncertain branch.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_branch

anyOf.description:
Usage: Navigate the session tree, optionally summarizing the abandoned branch.
Inputs: Supply entryId and optional summarize and customInstructions.
Invariants: The entry must exist and the session must be idle; ask re-answer is unsupported over RPC.
Effects: Moves the current leaf and may create a summary unless cancelled.
Recovery: Inspect the tree and leaf after uncertainty before navigating again.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_navigate_tree

anyOf.description:
Usage: Prepare a user message for editing by moving the leaf before it.
Inputs: Supply the user message entryId.
Invariants: The session must have no snapshot-busy or pending asynchronous work; the old branch remains in the tree.
Effects: Persists the navigation, but does not submit edited text.
Recovery: Inspect session identity and leaf after uncertainty before editing or resending.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_edit_message

anyOf.description:
Usage: Abort branch summarization.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: This does not undo a summary already completed.
Effects: Signals the active branch summary to stop.
Recovery: Inspect the tree after uncertainty.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_abort_branch_summary

anyOf.description:
Usage: Read the session tree and current leaf.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: This is a current session snapshot and can change with navigation.
Effects: Reads the in-process tree without modifying it.
Recovery: Refresh after session or leaf changes.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_get_tree

anyOf.description:
Usage: Read session entries after an optional entry cursor.
Inputs: Omit since for all entries, or supply an existing entry id.
Invariants: Results exclude the cursor entry; an unknown id fails with unknown_since.
Effects: Reads the current session entry list and leaf.
Recovery: Restart without a cursor if the cursor is no longer valid.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_get_entries

anyOf.description:
Usage: Read the live transcript.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: This is the current in-memory transcript and may change during a run.
Effects: Reads messages without modifying them.
Recovery: Refresh after reconnecting or use bounded paging while idle.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_get_messages

anyOf.description:
Usage: Read a bounded page of the live transcript.
Inputs: Omit cursor for the first page; limit defaults to 100 and is at most 256.
Invariants: Pages are bounded by a byte budget; a transcript change makes cursors stale and streaming or compaction rejects paging.
Effects: Reads an in-memory snapshot without modifying the transcript.
Recovery: Restart from the first page after a stale cursor or once the session is idle.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_get_messages_page

anyOf.description:
Usage: List user messages available for branching.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Entry ids refer to the current session tree.
Effects: Reads branch candidates without navigating.
Recovery: Refresh after session or tree changes.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_get_branch_messages

anyOf.description:
Usage: Read the latest assistant text.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Text is omitted when there is no assistant text.
Effects: Reads the current transcript without modifying it.
Recovery: Refresh after the transcript changes.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_get_last_assistant_text

anyOf.description:
Usage: Set the session title.
Inputs: Supply name; surrounding whitespace is trimmed.
Invariants: The title belongs to the current session.
Effects: Changes the session name.
Recovery: Read current state after uncertainty before reapplying.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_set_session_name

anyOf.description:
Usage: Set or clear an entry label.
Inputs: Supply entryId; omit label to clear it.
Invariants: The entry belongs to the current session tree.
Effects: Changes the entry's label.
Recovery: Read the tree after uncertainty before reapplying.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_set_label

anyOf.description:
Usage: Export the transcript to HTML.
Inputs: outputPath may be omitted to use the default.
Invariants: The result returns the output path.
Effects: Writes an HTML file to disk.
Recovery: Inspect the output path after uncertainty before exporting again.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_export_html

anyOf.description:
Usage: Probe session lease ownership.
Inputs: Supply sessionIds.
Invariants: Held and unknown are separate classifications; unknown is not proof of an available lease.
Effects: Reads lease state without taking a lease.
Recovery: Probe again when unknown ownership can be resolved.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_get_session_lease

anyOf.description:
Usage: Install the host's tool catalog for this session.
Inputs: tools replaces the complete catalog; parameters are tool-defined JSON Schema.
Invariants: Calls and updates are correlated by request id, distinct from toolCallId.
Effects: Refreshes session tools; execution delegates to the connected host.
Recovery: Disconnect fails outstanding calls; reinstall the catalog after reconnect.

args.description: Host tool catalog installed into the current runner session.

tools.description: Complete replacement catalog; each tool's parameters is a host-defined JSON Schema.

^(.*)$.description: Extensible tool-defined JSON payload.

anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_set_host_tools

anyOf.description:
Usage: Register host-owned URI schemes.
Inputs: schemes is the complete replacement list.
Invariants: URI requests are correlated by id; cancellation names the original targetId.
Effects: Changes the process-wide URI router registrations owned by this bridge.
Recovery: Disconnect removes registrations and fails pending requests; register again on reconnect.

args.description: URI scheme registrations owned by the connected host bridge.

schemes.description: Complete replacement set of host-owned URI schemes.

anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_set_host_uri_schemes

anyOf.description:
Usage: Ask a side question or continue an existing record.
Inputs: question is text; omit recordId to start a record.
Invariants: Only one side question runs at a time; deltas and snapshots carry recordId.
Effects: Streams an answer and checkpoints turns to the session history sidecar.
Recovery: Inspect history after an uncertain response before submitting another question.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_btw

anyOf.description:
Usage: Cancel the active side question.
Inputs: Omit recordId to target the active record, or supply its id.
Invariants: cancelled reports whether a matching active request was cancelled.
Effects: Interrupts the answer; its lifecycle is checkpointed.
Recovery: Read history to determine the outcome if the response is lost.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_btw_cancel

anyOf.description:
Usage: Read side-question history for the current session.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Records are newest first and include follow-up turns.
Effects: Reads the session history sidecar without changing it.
Recovery: Retry a failed read; history reflects saved checkpoints.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_get_btw_history

anyOf.description:
Usage: Request composer ghost text.
Inputs: text and cursor, an in-range UTF-16 offset.
Invariants: Disabled prediction, ineligible cursor positions and superseded waiting requests return null.
Effects: May invoke the configured prediction backend; concurrent typing is coalesced.
Recovery: Request again with current text and cursor rather than applying stale suffixes.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_predict_word

anyOf.description:
Usage: Report whether a prediction was accepted.
Inputs: text, UTF-16 cursor, suggestion and accepted flag.
Invariants: Feedback is ignored when prediction is off or the cursor is ineligible.
Effects: Sends feedback to the configured prediction backend when applicable.
Recovery: A lost response does not establish whether feedback was recorded.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_predict_word_feedback

anyOf.description:
Usage: Start draft dictation on the runner microphone.
Inputs: captureId is a caller-chosen nonempty correlation id of at most 128 characters.
Invariants: Speech-to-text must be enabled and live voice inactive; frames carry captureId.
Effects: Starts microphone capture and emits state and transcript frames.
Recovery: On disconnect capture stops; observe its end before starting another.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_dictation_start

anyOf.description:
Usage: Stop draft dictation and obtain final text.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Final transcription is flushed before returning.
Effects: Stops capture and emits its end frame.
Recovery: Use the correlated end frame if the response is lost.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_dictation_stop

anyOf.description:
Usage: Start live voice using the runner microphone.
Inputs: voice and instructions are optional.
Invariants: Dictation must not be active; only one live session is bound to the session.
Effects: Opens a live voice connection and microphone; delegated work uses session tools.
Recovery: Disconnect stops the live session; reconnect explicitly to resume.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_live_start

anyOf.description:
Usage: Connect live voice using a remote WebRTC offer.
Inputs: sdpOffer must be nonempty; voice and instructions are optional.
Invariants: Dictation must not be active; the returned SDP answer belongs to this connection.
Effects: Starts live voice without opening the runner microphone.
Recovery: A lost answer requires reconciling the active session before reconnecting.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_live_connect

anyOf.description:
Usage: End live voice.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Stops the session bound to this runner session.
Effects: Closes the live connection and microphone if open.
Recovery: Reconnect explicitly to start voice again.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_live_stop

anyOf.description:
Usage: Control live microphone mute.
Inputs: Supply muted to set it, or omit it to toggle.
Invariants: The result reports the resulting mute state.
Effects: Changes live voice microphone state.
Recovery: After an uncertain toggle, set an explicit state instead of toggling again.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_live_mute

anyOf.description:
Usage: Inspect the current session's observed subagent roster.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: The in-memory roster only knows lifecycle events observed since watching began, ordered by index then id.
Effects: Returns a snapshot without changing subagents.
Recovery: Refresh the snapshot; it is not a durable complete history.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_get_subagents

anyOf.description:
Usage: Incrementally read an owned subagent transcript.
Inputs: Identify it by subagentId or sessionFile; fromByte defaults to zero and is a UTF-8 byte offset.
Invariants: Only current-session-owned transcripts are accessible; only newline-complete entries advance nextByte. An offset past EOF resets to zero.
Effects: Reads the transcript file without modifying it; messages are the message entries in order.
Recovery: Resume at nextByte; on reset discard the old view and rebuild from zero.

fromByte.description: UTF-8 byte offset; defaults to zero and is truncated to a nonnegative integer.

sessionFile.description: Previously observed transcript path owned by the current session.

subagentId.description: Observed subagent id; when supplied it takes precedence over sessionFile.

anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_get_subagent_messages

anyOf.description:
Usage: Select subagent event forwarding for this session.
Inputs: level is off, progress, or events.
Invariants: events includes forwarded agent events; progress forwards lifecycle and progress.
Effects: Changes the in-memory subscription level.
Recovery: Reapply the desired level after reconnecting.

args.description: Select no forwarding, lifecycle/progress, or full subagent event forwarding for this session.

anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_set_subagent_subscription

anyOf.description:
Usage: Hard-cancel an owned running subagent.
Inputs: subagentId identifies the observed spawn.
Invariants: cancelled is false if it is no longer owned or already gone.
Effects: Releases the agent with an abort tombstone and aborts its session.
Recovery: Inspect the roster after an uncertain response; cancellation may already have occurred.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_cancel_subagent

anyOf.description:
Usage: Steer an owned running subagent.
Inputs: subagentId and nonblank message.
Invariants: Ownership is rechecked after resolving the live agent; success means acceptance, not completion.
Effects: Sends a steering prompt to that subagent.
Recovery: After an uncertain response inspect its transcript before resending to avoid duplicate steering.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_steer_subagent

anyOf.description:
Usage: List OAuth providers and authentication state.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Availability comes from the provider catalog and authentication from credential storage.
Effects: Reads current in-process registry and stored credential state.
Recovery: Refresh the list after login or logout.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_get_login_providers

anyOf.description:
Usage: Authenticate an OAuth provider interactively.
Inputs: providerId names a known provider; answer numeric-id prompts with login_input_response.
Invariants: Prompts time out after ten minutes; omitted or null answers cancel the input.
Effects: Stores credentials, refreshes provider discovery online and refreshes scoped models.
Recovery: Check authentication state after uncertainty; login may have stored credentials before a refresh failed.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_login

anyOf.description:
Usage: List credentials available for provider logout.
Inputs: providerId is required.
Invariants: Accounts are scoped to the requested provider and current session.
Effects: Reads credential storage without removing credentials.
Recovery: Refresh the list before choosing an account.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_get_logout_accounts

anyOf.description:
Usage: Remove a stored provider credential.
Inputs: providerId and integer credentialId identify the account.
Invariants: A credential not stored for that provider is an error; remainingSource is optional.
Effects: Removes the credential and updates session authentication.
Recovery: Re-list accounts after an uncertain response rather than assuming removal failed.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_logout

anyOf.description:
Usage: Propose commits for the workspace while the session is settled.
Inputs: Optional context guides the proposal; changelog false disables changelog detection. Optional requestId correlates unsolicited commit_plan_progress frames.
Invariants: Returns null if no staged changes remain after staging the workspace; progress is emitted only when requestId is supplied.
Effects: Stages all workspace changes, including partially staged files; may invoke a model.
Recovery: Inspect the Git index after errors or lost responses; staging is not rolled back.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_commit_plan

anyOf.description:
Usage: Apply a proposed or edited commit plan while the session is settled.
Inputs: plan contains commit groups, dependencies and changelog proposals.
Invariants: Split plans must cover staged files and have valid dependency order.
Effects: Writes changelogs and creates commits; split plans unstage and stage hunks in dependency order.
Recovery: Inspect commits, changelog and index after failure; partial application is not rolled back.

plan.description: Generated single or split commit plan, its changelog edits, warnings and fallback indicator.

items.description: Proposed changelog entries and optional deletions grouped by section for a repository path.
Proposed commit message and files, optionally narrowing changes to hunks and declaring dependencies on other commits.

end.description: Inclusive end line; must be at least start.

items.description: Select all changes, one-based hunk indices, or an inclusive line range in a repository-relative file.

anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_commit_apply

anyOf.description:
Usage: Generate a PR title and body from the current branch and staged diff.
Inputs: base is a Git ref; context and plannedMessages are optional.
Invariants: Commits are oldest first; the staged diff is bounded and generation requires changes.
Effects: Reads Git and session history and calls the configured model; does not create a PR.
Recovery: Retry generation if needed; output can differ and malformed model output falls back to the log.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_generate_pr_description

anyOf.description:
Usage: List jobs and services scoped to the current session.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: This is a live snapshot; a service-list failure appears in servicesError.
Effects: Reads runner and daemon state without starting work.
Recovery: Refresh the snapshot after a restart or service-list failure.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_get_jobs

anyOf.description:
Usage: Read one job or service's output.
Inputs: Supply its id, kind, incarnation and generation from a current snapshot; cursor defaults to zero.
Invariants: Identity is bound to the runner generation and job incarnation; bash sources honor the cursor, while service logs and non-stream sources return bounded snapshots from zero. Output may be truncated.
Effects: Reads current output without cancelling the job.
Recovery: On stale_generation or job_not_found refresh the list; invalid_args requires correcting the request.

generation.description: Runner generation from the job snapshot.

incarnation.description: Identity token from the job snapshot; detects replacement.

anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_get_job_output

anyOf.description:
Usage: Request cancellation of a scoped job or service.
Inputs: Supply its id, kind, incarnation and generation from a current snapshot.
Invariants: A cancellation request is not proof that work has stopped; stale identities and forbidden targets fail.
Effects: Signals the selected job or service; already produced output is not rolled back.
Recovery: Refresh the snapshot and inspect status after uncertainty; do not reuse an identity from a replaced runner.

generation.description: Runner generation from the job snapshot.

incarnation.description: Identity token from the job snapshot; detects replacement.

anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_cancel_job

anyOf.description:
Usage: Select which native session events are forwarded to this host.
Inputs: events is null for all or an array of event types; messageUpdates optionally selects full or delta.
Invariants: Message ids are assigned even to filtered events; delta is the default mode.
Effects: Changes the in-memory forwarding filter, not the underlying session activity.
Recovery: Reapply the desired filter after reconnect; fetch a snapshot when events may have been missed.
anyOf.title: RunnerRequest_set_event_filter

HostReply_activateHostArtifact.description:
Reply to activateHostArtifact; match the request id. Outer ok:false reports a transport or dispatch error; outer ok:true can contain an inline logical operation failure (result.ok:false). Successful media and file chunks use binary frames, not inline JSON bytes. Usage: Install a selected staged binary or pair and restart the standalone daemon.
Inputs: Supply its staged upload ID, an operation ID, the target executable and its expected SHA-256. A paired deployment also supplies the staged runner ID and digest.
Invariants: Valid only on a supported standalone install and the server link that staged the artifacts. Replaying an admitted operation ID cannot trigger a second activation.
Effects: The worker verifies and preflights the resulting pair before force-draining, even when busy. Restart interrupts active sessions, terminals and host operations; pending results can be lost. It backs up existing binaries before replacing them. If the runner is absent, a paired deployment creates it without overwriting a concurrently added file. The worker restarts the unit once; acceptance is not completion.
Recovery: Read hostArtifactActivationStatus with the same operation ID after reconnect. Never blindly retry or automatically roll back a restart.
HostReply_activateHostArtifact.title: HostReply_activateHostArtifact

HostReply_hierarchy.description:
Reply to hierarchy; match the request id. Outer ok:false reports a transport or dispatch error; outer ok:true can contain an inline logical operation failure (result.ok:false). Successful media and file chunks use binary frames, not inline JSON bytes. Usage: Inspect or change the registered project/workspace/session hierarchy.
Inputs: Action-specific IDs, host paths, imports or project metadata select the operation; nullable metadata clears it.
Invariants: Discovery yields candidates; importing or registering changes canonical membership and is distinct from filesystem discovery. listProjectIcons scans at most five directory levels below the project root and examines at most 2,000 entries, returning at most 24 icons of at most 256 KiB each. It skips hidden names, symlinks, node_modules, vendor, dist and release, and applies Git ignore rules when available. Results are best-effort, not an exhaustive inventory.
Effects: Mutations persist hierarchy changes; list and discovery return snapshots.
Recovery: Re-read the hierarchy before repeating an uncertain mutation.
HostReply_hierarchy.title: HostReply_hierarchy

HostReply_openFile.description:
Reply to openFile; match the request id. Outer ok:false reports a transport or dispatch error; outer ok:true can contain an inline logical operation failure (result.ok:false). Successful media and file chunks use binary frames, not inline JSON bytes. Usage: Open a workspace file for chunked reading.
Inputs: File request identifies the host file and optional owner.
Invariants: The target must be a file; changes can invalidate the reader.
Effects: Allocates a host reader handle and returns its metadata.
Recovery: On file_changed, close and reopen instead of combining chunks from different versions.

HostReply_planning.description:
Reply to planning; match the request id. Outer ok:false reports a transport or dispatch error; outer ok:true can contain an inline logical operation failure (result.ok:false). Successful media and file chunks use binary frames, not inline JSON bytes. Usage: Read or edit the Notes & Tasks board on its owning daemon.
Inputs: Identify a registered Repo or System by kind and ID, then select an action. Browser preview reads board references; Improve reads only live attachments on the selected task. Launch reads use the claimed launch ID and version, never arbitrary image IDs. Begin and launch updates are internal.
Invariants: Edits check the saved revision. Begin pins the generated name, saved prompt and task images, never Notes. Launch updates compare the full previous record. Only an unadmitted Effort that needs review can replace its setup plan.
Effects: Persists board changes outside the checkout. Preparing an older launch for delivery keeps only pinned images still proven to belong to its task. Does not write to Git or run workspace setup or chat delivery.
Recovery: Read the board after a conflict or uncertain result. Never assume an unconfirmed launch transition was claimed.
HostReply_planning.title: HostReply_planning

HostReply_publishUpload.description:
Reply to publishUpload; match the request id. Outer ok:false reports a transport or dispatch error; outer ok:true can contain an inline logical operation failure (result.ok:false). Successful media and file chunks use binary frames, not inline JSON bytes. Usage: Publish a staged upload into a host directory.
Inputs: id identifies the staged upload; name, conflict strategy and optional owner select the destination.
Invariants: Protected targets are rejected and overwrite cannot replace directories or symbolic links.
Effects: Publishes, overwrites, or skips the target according to conflict strategy.
Recovery: upload_publish_uncertain means the outcome is indeterminate; inspect the target rather than blindly replaying.

HostReply_readBashOutput.description:

Inputs: sessionId and path identify the session output on the host.
Invariants: Oversized output returns a size and byte limit instead of the contents.
Effects: Reads existing output without changing it.

HostReply_readClone.description:
Reply to readClone; match the request id. Outer ok:false reports a transport or dispatch error; outer ok:true can contain an inline logical operation failure (result.ok:false). Successful media and file chunks use binary frames, not inline JSON bytes. Usage: Read incremental clone progress.
Inputs: id identifies the clone and cursor is a UTF-8 output byte position.
Invariants: reset signals that retained history no longer covers the requested cursor; terminal marks completion. Jobs expire after inactivity.
Effects: Reads retained progress frames and refreshes the job's idle timer.
Recovery: On reset replace the previous progress view; use the returned cursor for the next read.

Successful media and file chunks use binary frames, not inline JSON bytes. Usage: Read a chunk from an open file reader.

HostReply_readSession.description:
Reply to readSession; match the request id. Outer ok:false reports a transport or dispatch error; outer ok:true can contain an inline logical operation failure (result.ok:false). Successful media and file chunks use binary frames, not inline JSON bytes. Usage: Read session metadata, navigation tree and display context.
Inputs: Supply session ID, deferred-content options, and optionally tail; before requires the previous historyRevision.
Invariants: Tail pages are chronological and exclusive on the active branch; continuation pages omit metadata and tree. Changed file generations or invalid branch cursors fail with session_history_changed. Without tail the full history is returned. This is not a live runner.
Effects: Reads session data without starting a process.
Recovery: Discard partial pages and synchronize after session_history_changed; inspect the logical operation result as well as the outer response.

HostReply_readSessionState.description:
Reply to readSessionState; match the request id. Outer ok:false reports a transport or dispatch error; outer ok:true can contain an inline logical operation failure (result.ok:false). Successful media and file chunks use binary frames, not inline JSON bytes. Usage: Read file-only session state.
Inputs: Supply session ID.
Invariants: The file-only result reports running false; it is not a live process query.
Effects: Reads session state without starting a runner.
Recovery: Resolve session_not_found before retrying.

Successful media and file chunks use binary frames, not inline JSON bytes. Usage: Manage Systems and Efforts on one host daemon.
Inputs: Select an action with its host paths, IDs, settings, or preview confirmation. Service controls identify a saved service and never take a command or environment override.
Invariants: Creation captures resolved commits and the System definition. Planned admission requires the daemon's current launch version and plan. Paths and branches remain stable on rename. A running service is not a readiness check.
Effects: Actions can change definitions, admit durable setup, control daemon-owned service PTYs, or clean up Efforts. Cleanup does not remove branches, push commits, or close PRs.
Recovery: List host state after uncertain delivery. Retry incomplete setup explicitly and refresh a cleanup preview before resuming removal. A daemon restart does not restart services.
HostReply_systems.title: HostReply_systems

HostReply_terminals.description:
Reply to terminals; match the request id. Outer ok:false reports a transport or dispatch error; outer ok:true can contain an inline logical operation failure (result.ok:false). Successful media and file chunks use binary frames, not inline JSON bytes. Usage: Manage host-daemon terminals for a workspace.
Inputs: The action selects cwd, terminal id, dimensions, input text, or viewer focus state.
Invariants: IDs and snapshots belong to the daemon; cursors order output, not filesystem bytes. A service terminal can retain output after its process exits.
Effects: Create starts an interactive login shell using the host account's shell, falling back to the daemon's SHELL or /bin/sh when unavailable; it inherits the daemon's HOME when set. Input, resize, focus and close change terminal state; list and snapshot observe it.
Recovery: Re-list or snapshot after disconnection; a restarted daemon does not preserve terminal processes.

Invariants: Reusing an ID with different metadata conflicts; acknowledgements are attempt-bound. Completed attachment receipts require the retained target to exist, not merely a stored receipt.
Effects: Creates or resumes daemon-local staged data; inactive staged files are swept after 24 hours.
Recovery: Resume with matching metadata and use the acknowledged offset, not stale attempt acknowledgements.

HostRequest_activateHostArtifact.description:
Usage: Install a selected staged binary or pair and restart the standalone daemon.
Inputs: Supply its staged upload ID, an operation ID, the target executable and its expected SHA-256. A paired deployment also supplies the staged runner ID and digest.
Invariants: Valid only on a supported standalone install and the server link that staged the artifacts. Replaying an admitted operation ID cannot trigger a second activation.
Effects: The worker verifies and preflights the resulting pair before force-draining, even when busy. Restart interrupts active sessions, terminals and host operations; pending results can be lost. It backs up existing binaries before replacing them. If the runner is absent, a paired deployment creates it without overwriting a concurrently added file. The worker restarts the unit once; acceptance is not completion.
Recovery: Read hostArtifactActivationStatus with the same operation ID after reconnect. Never blindly retry or automatically roll back a restart.

args.description: An explicit standalone host activation request; contains no filesystem path.

artifactId.description: ID from a successful staging operation on this daemon and server link.

operationId.description: Operator action ID used to read the outcome across restart. Reusing it cannot start a second install.

runner.description: Matching staged runner to install with target keylime before one restart.

sha256.description: Expected SHA-256 of the exact binary from a trusted source, in lowercase hex.

target.description: The installed standalone executable to replace.

HostRequest_activateHostArtifact.title: HostRequest_activateHostArtifact

HostRequest_addProject.description:
Usage: Register a project.
Inputs: Supply path and optional launch configuration.
Invariants: Invalid paths produce project-specific errors; worktrees resolve to their main repository.
Effects: Updates the daemon project registry.
Recovery: Inspect the registry after an uncertain result before repeating.

launchConfig.description: Workspace-level omp launch configuration; only affects omp children spawned for that workspace.

Inputs: Supply session ID.
Invariants: The session must exist.
Effects: Moves the session and artifacts into the archive.
Recovery: Inspect active and archived inventories after an uncertain response before repeating.
HostRequest_archiveSession.title: HostRequest_archiveSession

HostRequest_browseDirectories.description:
Usage: Browse host directories.
Inputs: path selects a host directory or null selects the initial location.
Invariants: Results describe host filesystem directories, not registered projects.
Effects: Reads directory entries.
Recovery: Refresh after filesystem changes or choose an accessible path.
HostRequest_browseDirectories.title: HostRequest_browseDirectories

HostRequest_browserCapture.description:
Usage: Capture one session-owned browser tab.
Inputs: Supply the exact session ID and tab ID from discovery.
Invariants: No caller-supplied CDP endpoint or browser input is accepted; capture is bounded.
Effects: Captures a single JPEG without changing browser lifecycle.
Recovery: Rediscover after tab or session changes.
HostRequest_browserCapture.title: HostRequest_browserCapture

HostRequest_browserControl.description:
Usage: Control a session-owned browser tab with a bounded ordered batch.
Inputs: Supply the session ID, target ID and 1–64 actions from the browser control contract.
Invariants: Whole-batch validation precedes dispatch; the runner rechecks ownership before each action; no runner or browser is started and no CDP endpoint is exposed.
Effects: Applies actions sequentially through one CDP session; failure stops the batch and may leave an applied prefix.
Recovery: Delivery of a prefix may be uncertain; never automatically retry the batch or remaining actions.

control.description: A bounded ordered batch addressed to one exact session-owned Chromium target. HTTP request bodies are limited to 1 MiB. No atomicity or exclusive control against other viewers or the agent is promised.

actions.description: Actions applied sequentially in array order after whole-batch validation. Ownership is rechecked before each action. Failure may leave an applied prefix; never retry the batch automatically.

buttons.description: Pressed mouse buttons as the DOM/CDP bitmask: left 1, right 2, middle 4, back 8, forward 16.

HostRequest_browserControl.title: HostRequest_browserControl

Inputs: id identifies the host clone job.
Invariants: Returned progress reports its resulting state; cancellation can race completion.

HostRequest_cancelClone.title: HostRequest_cancelClone

HostRequest_chatRolesList.description:
Usage: Resolve chat roles for a workspace on the selected daemon.
Inputs: Supply an absolute workspace cwd and optionally the current composer thinking selector and current provider/model ID pair.
Invariants: Uses the workspace's native OMP settings and registry without returning secrets; the model pair supplies the temporary runner's default-role fallback.
Effects: Starts a temporary runner on the daemon.
Recovery: Correct the path or configuration and retry on the same host.
HostRequest_chatRolesList.title: HostRequest_chatRolesList

HostRequest_close.description:
Usage: Leave a runner channel.
Inputs: Supply the channel identity.
Invariants: Closing this server's membership does not kill a peer's process.
Effects: The daemon manages abandonment and idle cleanup.
Recovery: Reconcile membership after a lost response before assuming the process stopped.
HostRequest_close.title: HostRequest_close

HostRequest_closeFile.description:

Inputs: id identifies the host reader.
Invariants: The handle is no longer usable after close.
Effects: Releases reader resources.
Recovery: If uncertain, discard the handle and open a new reader when needed.
HostRequest_closeFile.title: HostRequest_closeFile

HostRequest_createWorkspace.description:
Usage: Start an asynchronous workspace creation job.
Inputs: projectPath, branch, mode, baseRef and name select the host checkout and branch. New branches can use refs/pull/<number>/head for GitHub pull requests.
Invariants: The job captures its pipeline and progresses through stages; failure can leave partial work.
Effects: Runs configured commands and creates a worktree and registration.
Recovery: Poll the job and inspect the checkout before retrying after an uncertain response.

input.description: Request to create a workspace under a host project using a branch mode, branch, base ref and name.

mode.description: Choose an existing local or remote branch, or create a new branch from a base ref.

HostRequest_createWorkspace.title: HostRequest_createWorkspace

HostRequest_defaultCwd.title: HostRequest_defaultCwd

HostRequest_deleteSession.description:
Usage: Delete the selected session while preserving its child sessions.
Inputs: Supply the selected ID and the caller's liveSessionIds snapshot; the daemon also fences live processes.
Invariants: Direct children keep their files. Eligible parentSession references are rewritten to the deleted session's parent, preserving path-versus-ID form; live or oversized child files are not rewritten and skipped rewrites are reported.
Effects: Deletes the selected session and atomically rewrites eligible direct-child headers; it does not delete descendants.
Recovery: Reconcile the selected session, preserved children and skippedChildren after an uncertain response before repeating the deletion; a successful deletion does not prove every child reference was rewritten.
HostRequest_deleteSession.title: HostRequest_deleteSession

HostRequest_editLease.description:

Inputs: Supply channel and desired on/off state.
Invariants: Conflicting peers are refused before editing; ownership follows membership.
Effects: Changes the daemon's editing fence.
Recovery: Re-establish membership and lease before editing after disconnect.
HostRequest_editLease.title: HostRequest_editLease

HostRequest_exportSession.description:

Inputs: Supply session ID.
Invariants: The session and omp executable must be available.
Effects: Runs omp export using a temporary file, then returns HTML and a suggested filename; it does not start a session runner.
Recovery: Restore the missing session or executable before retrying.
HostRequest_exportSession.title: HostRequest_exportSession

Invariants: Results can be truncated and reflect the index rather than a guaranteed live filesystem snapshot.
Effects: May refresh the index; otherwise reads indexed state.
Recovery: Refresh and repeat the query when stale results matter.

HostRequest_hideProject.description:
Usage: Hide a project.
Inputs: Supply its path.
Invariants: Hidden registry entries suppress sidebar rediscovery until added again.
Effects: Updates registry visibility.
Recovery: Inspect registry state after an uncertain response.
HostRequest_hideProject.title: HostRequest_hideProject

HostRequest_hierarchy.description:
Usage: Inspect or change the registered project/workspace/session hierarchy.
Inputs: Action-specific IDs, host paths, imports or project metadata select the operation; nullable metadata clears it.
Invariants: Discovery yields candidates; importing or registering changes canonical membership and is distinct from filesystem discovery. listProjectIcons scans at most five directory levels below the project root and examines at most 2,000 entries, returning at most 24 icons of at most 256 KiB each. It skips hidden names, symlinks, node_modules, vendor, dist and release, and applies Git ignore rules when available. Results are best-effort, not an exhaustive inventory.
Effects: Mutations persist hierarchy changes; list and discovery return snapshots.
Recovery: Re-read the hierarchy before repeating an uncertain mutation.

anyOf.description: Workspace-level omp launch configuration; only affects omp children spawned for that workspace.

advisor.description: Whether to launch with advisor mode.

extraArgs.description: Extra OMP CLI args, stored as an array.

HostRequest_hierarchy.title: HostRequest_hierarchy

HostRequest_home.description:
Usage: Get the host home directory.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: The returned path belongs to the host machine, not the browser.
Effects: Reads process environment state.
Recovery: Re-query after reconnecting to a host.
HostRequest_home.title: HostRequest_home

HostRequest_hostArtifactActivationStatus.description:
Usage: Read the outcome of a standalone host activation.
Inputs: Supply the original operation ID.
Invariants: State belongs to the daemon and the server relationship that requested the activation. A missing receipt does not prove that the operation ran or failed.
Effects: Reads durable state without installing, restarting or retrying.
Recovery: Poll after the link returns. If the outcome stays unknown, inspect the service and backup on the host before retrying.

args.description: Read an activation previously sent to this daemon.

operationId.description: Operator action ID used to read the outcome across restart. Reusing it cannot start a second install.

HostRequest_hostArtifactActivationStatus.title: HostRequest_hostArtifactActivationStatus

HostRequest_hostInstalledBinaryDigests.description:
Usage: Read the SHA-256 digests of the managed standalone binaries.
Inputs: None.
Invariants: Only the authenticated current controller can read them. The daemon chooses both paths. A null runner digest means the managed runner is absent.
Effects: Reads the installed files on each request without changing them.
Recovery: Retry after reconnect, or inspect the managed binaries if they cannot be read.
HostRequest_hostInstalledBinaryDigests.title: HostRequest_hostInstalledBinaryDigests

HostRequest_hostSettingsGet.description:
Usage: Read this daemon's Keylime policy.
Inputs: None.
Invariants: Does not include environment or provider secrets.
Effects: Reads local policy.
Recovery: Retry on the same host after reconnect.
HostRequest_hostSettingsGet.title: HostRequest_hostSettingsGet

HostRequest_hostSettingsSet.description:
Usage: Patch this daemon's Keylime policy.
Inputs: Supply the fields to change; retention uses whole days or null to keep uploads.
Invariants: Settings do not propagate to any other host.
Effects: Saves locally and applies to subsequent daemon activity.
Recovery: Read back the host's policy after an uncertain reply.

args.description: Patch one daemon's policy, preserving omitted fields.

agentToolsEnabled.description: Enable cross-session agent tools on this daemon.

autoResumeSessions.description: Resume sessions interrupted on this daemon.

uploadRetentionDays.description: Days to retain sent uploads; null retains them indefinitely.

HostRequest_hostSettingsSet.title: HostRequest_hostSettingsSet

HostRequest_inspectUploads.description:
Usage: Inspect upload destination conflicts.
Inputs: directory is a host path; names are destination basenames and owner supplies session context.
Invariants: Protected targets are rejected; nonReplaceable includes directories and symbolic links among conflicts.
Effects: Reads destination metadata without publishing files.
Recovery: Reinspect immediately before a decision; filesystem state can change.

owner.description: Derived from a live wrapper or durable creation journal, never browser cwd.

HostRequest_inspectUploads.title: HostRequest_inspectUploads

HostRequest_invalidateSessionLists.description:
Usage: Invalidate session and workspace inventories.
Inputs: An optional path scopes the notification.
Invariants: Void success omits res.result in JSON.
Effects: Invalidates cached inventories and notifies linked servers.
Recovery: Refresh inventory after reconnect if notification delivery was uncertain.
HostRequest_invalidateSessionLists.title: HostRequest_invalidateSessionLists

HostRequest_listArchives.description:
Usage: List archived sessions.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Results are ordered newest first and represent a snapshot.
Effects: Reads archives without starting a runner.
Recovery: Refresh after archive or restore changes.
HostRequest_listArchives.title: HostRequest_listArchives

HostRequest_listFiles.description:
Usage: List a workspace directory.
Inputs: File request identifies the host path and optional session owner; showHidden controls hidden entries.
Invariants: The target must be a directory and access restrictions apply.
Effects: Reads a point-in-time filesystem listing.
Recovery: Refresh the listing after filesystem changes or reconnect.

input.description: Workspace file path segments and nullable session context, with optional derived owner used for access checks.

owner.description: Derived session owner for host access checks, not a browser-supplied cwd authority.

segments.description: Segments used to resolve the file path on the host.

HostRequest_listFiles.title: HostRequest_listFiles

HostRequest_listFilesInRoot.description:
Usage: List a directory confined to a root.
Inputs: File request selects a host path; root may be null.
Invariants: Paths outside an enforced root are rejected with outside_root.
Effects: Reads a filesystem listing.
Recovery: Correct the target or refresh after changes.

input.description: Workspace file path segments and nullable session context, with optional derived owner used for access checks.

owner.description: Derived session owner for host access checks, not a browser-supplied cwd authority.

segments.description: Segments used to resolve the file path on the host.

HostRequest_listFilesInRoot.title: HostRequest_listFilesInRoot

HostRequest_listProjects.description:
Usage: List the host project registry.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Raw entries include hidden projects and are a snapshot.
Effects: Reads registry data without starting a runner.
Recovery: Refresh after registry changes.
HostRequest_listProjects.title: HostRequest_listProjects

HostRequest_listSessionIdsForRestore.description:
Usage: Check active session IDs before restore.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: This strict inventory is uncached; failure cannot establish absence.
Effects: Reads active IDs without starting a runner.
Recovery: Resolve the failure and repeat the inventory before admitting restore.
HostRequest_listSessionIdsForRestore.title: HostRequest_listSessionIdsForRestore

HostRequest_listSessions.description:
Usage: List the host's sessions.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Inventory can be cached and is a snapshot.
Effects: Reads inventory without starting a runner.
Recovery: Refresh after invalidation or reconnect when a current list is needed.
HostRequest_listSessions.title: HostRequest_listSessions

HostRequest_listWorktrees.description:
Usage: List worktrees for a checkout.
Inputs: cwd is a host path.
Invariants: Results distinguish the main checkout and current worktree; branch may be null.
Effects: Reads Git worktree state.
Recovery: Refresh after worktrees or branches change.
HostRequest_listWorktrees.title: HostRequest_listWorktrees

HostRequest_modelsList.description:
Usage: Load the target daemon's model choices.
Inputs: Set refresh to rediscover models.
Invariants: Uses the daemon's OMP settings and credentials; returns no credential values.
Effects: Reads the host cache or queries the host's OMP runner.
Recovery: Retry on the same host, or inspect that host's OMP configuration.
HostRequest_modelsList.title: HostRequest_modelsList

HostRequest_open.description:
Usage: Join or start a runner.
Inputs: Provide session identity, launch settings and optional preparation or expected channel.
Invariants: Shared processes are joined, not replaced; trusted membership and startup fences apply. Cold startup can wait channelReadyMs plus opTimeoutMs.
Effects: Establishes membership; preparation protects a pending command across disconnects.
Recovery: Rejoin the expected channel after uncertainty rather than assuming a new process was started.

args.description: Join an existing daemon-owned session, or start it if no process owns it. Membership, not WebSocket lifetime, controls interest.

expectedChannel.description: Rejoin only this channel; prevents adopting an unrelated replacement.

launch.description: A launch request. A linked-host start uses the daemon's own provider credentials; a pure join starts nothing.

creationId.description: Stable identity of an independent start; retry arguments must remain identical.

sessionFile.description: Session transcript path on the daemon machine, checked against its session roots.

spawnModel.description: Provider/model identifier bound before resuming a session.

launch.title: SpawnRequest

preparing.description: Protect this channel while a submitted command is being prepared.

args.title: OpenChannelRequest

HostRequest_open.title: HostRequest_open

HostRequest_openBashOutput.description:
Usage: Open session bash output for chunked reading.
Inputs: sessionId and path identify the host output file.
Invariants: The returned reader refers to the opened file version.
Effects: Creates a reader handle; close it when finished.
Recovery: Reopen if the handle is lost or the file changes.
HostRequest_openBashOutput.title: HostRequest_openBashOutput

HostRequest_openFile.description:
Usage: Open a workspace file for chunked reading.
Inputs: File request identifies the host file and optional owner.
Invariants: The target must be a file; changes can invalidate the reader.
Effects: Allocates a host reader handle and returns its metadata.
Recovery: On file_changed, close and reopen instead of combining chunks from different versions.

input.description: Workspace file path segments and nullable session context, with optional derived owner used for access checks.

owner.description: Derived session owner for host access checks, not a browser-supplied cwd authority.

segments.description: Segments used to resolve the file path on the host.

HostRequest_openFile.title: HostRequest_openFile

HostRequest_planning.description:
Usage: Read or edit the Notes & Tasks board on its owning daemon.
Inputs: Identify a registered Repo or System by kind and ID, then select an action. Browser preview reads board references; Improve reads only live attachments on the selected task. Launch reads use the claimed launch ID and version, never arbitrary image IDs. Begin and launch updates are internal.
Invariants: Edits check the saved revision. Begin pins the generated name, saved prompt and task images, never Notes. Launch updates compare the full previous record. Only an unadmitted Effort that needs review can replace its setup plan.
Effects: Persists board changes outside the checkout. Preparing an older launch for delivery keeps only pinned images still proven to belong to its task. Does not write to Git or run workspace setup or chat delivery.
Recovery: Read the board after a conflict or uncertain result. Never assume an unconfirmed launch transition was claimed.

operation.description: Daemon planning operation. Launch lifecycle mutations are internal to the web server.

images.description: Replacement attachment list. Use IDs to keep existing images, or include new image bytes. Omit to keep the list unchanged.

data.description: Base64 image bytes, without a data URL prefix.

notes.description: Free-form Markdown saved verbatim outside the checkout.

images.description: Replacement attachment list. Use IDs to keep existing images, or include new image bytes. Omit to keep the list unchanged.

data.description: Base64 image bytes, without a data URL prefix.

prompt.description: Full task brief, including line breaks, sent verbatim. If empty, the one-line task description is sent instead.

status.description: Board column. Launch moves a task to In progress; a linked workspace's merge, deletion, or successful Ship moves it to Done. System tasks complete after all Effort member workspaces are removed.

setup.description: Host-derived setup choices captured at admission for recovery of the same launch.

expected.description: Durable launch with the literal prompt and pinned task image snapshot. Legacy records without taskImagesOnly are not eligible for first-message delivery. Unknown delivery is never retried.

prompt.description: Full task brief, including line breaks, sent verbatim. If empty, the one-line task description is sent instead.

retrySetup.description: An explicit setup retry is pending acknowledgement from the owning daemon.

sendingSince.description: First-message claim time in epoch milliseconds.

setup.description: Host-derived setup choices captured at admission for recovery of the same launch.

taskImagesOnly.description: The launch image snapshot contains only proven task attachments.

next.description: Durable launch with the literal prompt and pinned task image snapshot. Legacy records without taskImagesOnly are not eligible for first-message delivery. Unknown delivery is never retried.

prompt.description: Full task brief, including line breaks, sent verbatim. If empty, the one-line task description is sent instead.

retrySetup.description: An explicit setup retry is pending acknowledgement from the owning daemon.

sendingSince.description: First-message claim time in epoch milliseconds.

setup.description: Host-derived setup choices captured at admission for recovery of the same launch.

taskImagesOnly.description: The launch image snapshot contains only proven task attachments.

owner.description: Stable Repo or System registration ID on the selected daemon, never a path.

HostRequest_planning.title: HostRequest_planning

HostRequest_ptySessions.description:
Usage: List live session terminals on this host.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Includes idle PTYs, not just active turns.
Effects: None.
Recovery: Retry after the host reconnects.
HostRequest_ptySessions.title: HostRequest_ptySessions

HostRequest_publishUpload.description:
Usage: Publish a staged upload into a host directory.
Inputs: id identifies the staged upload; name, conflict strategy and optional owner select the destination.
Invariants: Protected targets are rejected and overwrite cannot replace directories or symbolic links.
Effects: Publishes, overwrites, or skips the target according to conflict strategy.
Recovery: upload_publish_uncertain means the outcome is indeterminate; inspect the target rather than blindly replaying.

conflict.description: Existing upload target policy: reject, overwrite a replaceable file, or skip it.

owner.description: Derived from a live wrapper or durable creation journal, never browser cwd.

HostRequest_publishUpload.title: HostRequest_publishUpload

HostRequest_readBashOutput.description:
Usage: Read a session bash output file.
Inputs: sessionId and path identify the session output on the host.
Invariants: Oversized output returns a size and byte limit instead of the contents.
Effects: Reads existing output without changing it.
Recovery: Use chunked output reading when the result is too large.
HostRequest_readBashOutput.title: HostRequest_readBashOutput

HostRequest_readClone.description:
Usage: Read incremental clone progress.
Inputs: id identifies the clone and cursor is a UTF-8 output byte position.
Invariants: reset signals that retained history no longer covers the requested cursor; terminal marks completion. Jobs expire after inactivity.
Effects: Reads retained progress frames and refreshes the job's idle timer.
Recovery: On reset replace the previous progress view; use the returned cursor for the next read.
HostRequest_readClone.title: HostRequest_readClone

HostRequest_readContext.description:
Usage: Read active context, entry boundary or paged history.
Inputs: Supply ID, optional leaf and context options including sync cursor and limit.
Invariants: The active branch and pre-compaction selection determine the snapshot; malformed, missing or oversized files fail.
Effects: Reads session data without starting a process.
Recovery: Refresh the cursor or correct the file before retrying; check the logical result separately from link success.

options.description: Select active context, boundary IDs, or a cursor-based history page.

boundary.description: Return only active context entry IDs.

includePreCompaction.description: Include entries omitted from the active agent context.

HostRequest_readContext.title: HostRequest_readContext
